resources.description: In assessment writing, how well formative feedback explains why a response is right or wrong and directs the learner's next step, beyond a bare correct/incorrect verdict.

resources.label: Inclusivity
resources.description: Use of bias-free, culturally aware language that excludes no reader and lets every member of the audience see themselves addressed.

resources.label: Memorability
resources.description: The likelihood that key messages are retained after reading, aided by vivid phrasing, strong structure, and deliberate repetition of core ideas.

resources.label: Specificity
resources.description: Preference for precise, concrete detail — named mechanisms, numbers, examples — over vague buzzwords and generic marketing claims.

resources.label: Tone Alignment
resources.description: Fit between the writing's actual voice and the tone register specified for the piece and its audience.

resources.label: Readability Target
resources.description: The target reading level for the audience

resources.label: Grade 6-8
resources.description: Plain-language band: short sentences and common words for broad general audiences and must-read operational content.

resources.label: Grade 9-12
resources.description: High-school band: standard business prose for general professional audiences, admitting moderate sentence complexity and everyday business vocabulary.

resources.label: Graduate Professional
resources.description: Advanced band: dense, abstraction-heavy prose for expert professional readers, as in white papers and scholarly analysis.

resources.label: Technical Specialist
resources.description: Level defined by domain expertise rather than a grade band: unglossed specialist terminology for practitioners in the field, as in API references and technical specifications.

resources.label: Undergraduate
resources.description: College-level band: sustained argument and discipline-general terminology for educated readers outside the specialism.

resources.label: Tone Register
resources.description: The voice and formality level of the writing

resources.label: Conversational
resources.description: Warm, relatable voice using contractions and direct address; suited to eLearning and video, avoiding passive voice, abstract nouns, and bureaucratic language.

resources.label: Empathetic
resources.description: Supportive, understanding voice that acknowledges challenges; suited to change management and onboarding, never dismissive, trivialising, or jargon-laden.

resources.label: Formal
resources.description: Professional, objective, impersonal voice that avoids contractions, colloquialisms, and first person; suited to executive audiences and regulatory content.

resources.label: Inspirational
resources.description: Motivating, visionary, aspirational voice; suited to keynotes and change communication, avoiding negativity, hedging, and bureaucratic framing.

resources.label: Professional
resources.description: Clear, direct, authoritative but approachable voice — the default register for corporate learning; avoids slang, hedging, superlatives, and marketing framing without specifics.

resources.label: Writing Mode
resources.description: The primary purpose and context of the writing

resources.label: Assessment
resources.description: Content designed to evaluate knowledge, understanding, or skill; produces quiz and multiple-choice items, scenario and reflection prompts, rubric descriptors, and formative feedback text.

resources.label: Copywriting
resources.description: Persuasive content designed to drive action or conversion, including product-focused writing that translates features into benefits in precise, specific language rather than generic marketing claims.

resources.label: Editorial
resources.description: Content expressing a perspective, analysis, or informed opinion rather than instruction or specification; produces thought-leadership articles, executive summaries, white papers, blog posts, and newsletters.

resources.label: Instructional
resources.description: Content whose primary purpose is to teach, explain, or guide a learner through a process; produces course modules, learning guides, how-to and knowledge-base articles, and practice prompts.

resources.label: Scriptwriting
resources.description: Content written for spoken delivery or multimedia production, where the words are heard rather than read; produces video narration, podcast scripts, speaker notes, and voiceover copy.

resources.label: Technical
resources.description: Precise documentation of systems, processes, or specifications, where accuracy and completeness outrank persuasion; produces API documentation, technical specs, release notes, and configuration guides.

resources.label: ABCD Method
resources.description: Mager's framework for writing learning outcomes: Actor, Behaviour, Conditions, and Degree.

resources.label: Academic Bundle
resources.description: Formal 4-word phrase that creates distance between speaker and audience

resources.label: Accessibility Dimension
resources.description: Reference to accessibility, inclusion, or compliance as a quality dimension

resources.label: Accessibility Feature
resources.description: Accessibility-related visual elements

resources.label: Accessibility Violation
resources.description: WCAG violation accessibility barrier screen reader keyboard caption alt text contrast colour blindness

resources.label: Accessible Data Visualisation
resources.description: The architectural discipline of building non-visual access into data visualisations — dual visual and semantic structure, focus-driven audio description, live regions and sonification, designed in from the start.

resources.label: Accessible Media Production
resources.description: The cross-medium accessibility production layer — WCAG media success criteria, the legal frame, captions, audio description, tagged documents and VPAT procurement.

resources.label: Acoustic Leadership Pillars
resources.description: Four core pillars of executive presence measurable through digital signal processing: Authority, Engagement, Clarity, and Empathy.

resources.label: Action Learning Project
resources.description: References to long-term project-based learning where teams tackle real-world problems with periodic live review sessions

resources.label: Action Mapping
resources.description: Cathy Moore's performance-first design workflow starting from a measurable business goal, diagnosing ESKM barriers, cutting nonessential content and building realistic practice for required actions.

resources.label: Action Title
resources.description: A slide or section header that states a conclusion or insight in a full declarative sentence rather than a topic label.

resources.label: Action Title Principle
resources.description: Consulting standard where slide titles are complete sentences articulating a specific insight or conclusion.

resources.label: ADDIE Iterative
resources.description: Iterative application of the ADDIE model within project management, featuring a central evaluation hub and continuous monitoring and control.

resources.label: ADDIE Model
resources.description: The five-phase instructional design process model — Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation, Evaluation — used as a generic lifecycle for designing learning experiences.

resources.label: Account Qualification Agent
resources.description: Account Qualification Agent, delivered through the Sales Qualifier add-on for Journey Optimizer B2B Edition, uses AI to synthesize account and buying-group intelligence, generate personalized outreach, and autonomously prioritize and engage prospects so BDRs focus on the most promising opportunities while CRM data is kept up to date.

resources.label: Adobe Acrobat
resources.description: Adobe's PDF application for creating, editing, converting, reviewing, protecting and signing PDF documents, delivered on desktop, web and mobile and sold in several editions.

resources.label: Adobe Acrobat AI Assistant
resources.description: Acrobat AI Assistant is Acrobat's generative AI add-on that provides source-linked, conversational answers and summaries over a single PDF or a PDF Space, and lets you edit and create content (for example rewriting, outlining, presentations and audio overviews) across multiple documents via natural-language chat.

resources.label: Adobe Acrobat Analyzer
resources.description: Adobe Acrobat Analyzer is a GenAI document-intelligence capability in Acrobat Studio and Acrobat Sign that extracts structured, auditable data and key terms from large volumes of contracts and agreements, lets teams review and validate those terms across large contract sets, and use an AI Assistant to ask ad-hoc questions over collections to automate workflows and reduce risk.

resources.label: Adobe Acrobat extension for Chrome
resources.description: The Adobe Acrobat extension for Chrome lets you open PDFs in Acrobat's web or desktop viewer directly from the browser and provides tools to comment, fill and sign forms, convert and combine files, compress PDFs, and convert web pages into PDFs.

resources.label: Adobe Acrobat Create PDF
resources.description: Acrobat's online service that converts Office files and images to PDF.

resources.label: Adobe Acrobat (Desktop)
resources.description: The desktop surface of Acrobat — the installed application for PDF creation, editing, signing and review on Windows and macOS.

resources.label: Adobe Acrobat extension for Microsoft Edge
resources.description: The Adobe Acrobat extension for Microsoft Edge lets you open PDFs in Acrobat's viewer inside Edge and use Acrobat tools to comment, fill and sign, convert, combine, and organize PDFs, with an option to make Acrobat the default PDF viewer in the browser.

resources.label: Adobe Acrobat Export PDF
resources.description: Adobe Acrobat Export PDF is an online service that converts PDFs into editable Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, or RTF files and uses OCR to make scanned PDFs and images searchable and editable.

resources.label: Adobe Acrobat Express
resources.description: Adobe Acrobat Express is a subscription offering for business professionals that brings together Acrobat AI Assistant, PDF Spaces, core PDF tools (create, convert, export, protect, compress), and Adobe Express Premium in an English-only, AI-powered workspace (Acrobat Express home) available across desktop, web, and mobile.

resources.label: Acrobat Generate Presentation
resources.description: Generate Presentation in Acrobat Studio uses generative AI and Adobe Express Premium to turn prompts and source documents into polished, multi-slide presentations with narrative flow, professional layouts, and on-brand styling. Users can customize decks with Adobe Stock assets, charts, and media, then share and co-edit within the Acrobat/Express workspace.

resources.label: Acrobat Legal Templates
resources.description: Acrobat Legal Templates are curated, guided templates for common legal documents—such as NDAs, non-compete agreements, and other contracts—available to specific paid Acrobat plans and integrated into Acrobat's signing workflows to help users quickly draft and complete long-form agreements.

resources.label: Adobe Acrobat (Mobile)
resources.description: The mobile surface of Acrobat for reading, annotating, filling and signing PDFs on phones and tablets.

resources.label: Acrobat Online Services
resources.description: Acrobat Online Services refers to the cloud-connected Document Cloud capabilities—Acrobat web and mobile, online PDF tools, storage, PDF Spaces, Generate Presentation, and related Express/AI integrations—whose availability is controlled by the PDF Services setting in the Admin Console product profile. This entitlement is separate from the developer-facing PDF Services API and can be disabled while still allowing some local AI Assistant use on desktop/mobile.

resources.label: Adobe Acrobat PDF Pack
resources.description: Adobe Acrobat PDF Pack is an Acrobat subscription bundle of online PDF services that lets you create, convert, combine, compress, organize, and export PDFs, fill and sign forms, request e-signatures, and send and track documents, accessible from a web browser, Acrobat/Reader desktop, and mobile apps.

resources.label: Adobe Acrobat Pro
resources.description: The full edition of Acrobat for creating, editing, converting, protecting, signing and exporting PDFs.

resources.label: Adobe Acrobat Reader
resources.description: The free edition of Acrobat for reading, commenting on, filling and signing PDFs without paid Acrobat features.

resources.label: Adobe Acrobat Services
resources.description: Adobe Acrobat Services is Adobe's family of cloud-based document APIs—including PDF Services, PDF Embed, Document Generation, PDF Extract, PDF Electronic Seal, PDF Accessibility Auto-Tag, and Acrobat Sign APIs—that lets developers embed rich PDF and agreement workflows into web and server applications.

resources.label: Adobe Acrobat Sign
resources.description: Adobe's e-signature application for sending, signing, tracking and managing legally binding agreements as a cloud workflow.

resources.label: Adobe Acrobat Sign API
resources.description: Acrobat Sign's REST API for creating and managing agreements, embedding signing and retrieving signed documents in applications.

resources.label: Adobe Acrobat Standard
resources.description: Adobe Acrobat Standard is the Windows-only essentials edition of Acrobat that lets users create, edit, convert, and sign PDFs, offering a subset of Acrobat Pro capabilities for organizations that don't need the full advanced toolset.

resources.label: Adobe Acrobat Studio
resources.description: Adobe Acrobat Studio is Adobe's all-in-one content and document platform that combines Acrobat Pro (for advanced PDF editing and e-signatures), Acrobat AI Assistant and PDF Spaces (for document insight and collaboration), and Adobe Express Premium (for branded content creation), so teams can manage, understand, and create content in one place.

resources.label: Adobe Acrobat (Web)
resources.description: The browser surface of Acrobat for viewing, editing, converting and signing PDFs without an install.

resources.label: Adobe
resources.description: Adobe is a global software company whose products are organized primarily into Creative Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Document Cloud, alongside a Publishing and Advertising portfolio and an AI layer (including Adobe Firefly) that powers features across these clouds.

resources.label: Adobe AI Platform
resources.description: Adobe AI Platform is the foundation that powers CX Enterprise, bringing together Adobe Experience Platform, Agent Orchestrator, Experience Platform Agents, AI-first applications, CX Enterprise Coworker, CX language models, and trust, privacy, security, and governance services.

resources.label: Adobe Clean
resources.description: Adobe's proprietary typeface, the only typeface for Adobe's internal and external communications and licensed for Adobe use only; its weights, hierarchy and fallbacks are library knowledge.

resources.label: Adobe Developer Platform
resources.description: Adobe Developer Platform is Adobe's open developer platform, centered on developer.adobe.com, that provides APIs, events, SDKs, runtimes, tools, and documentation so developers can integrate with and extend Adobe Creative Cloud, Experience Cloud, Document Cloud, and Firefly Services across web and enterprise workflows.

resources.label: Adobe Icon
resources.description: The Adobe "A" symbol, Adobe's secondary brand identifier, used where space is small or Adobe is already identified elsewhere.

resources.label: Adobe Red
resources.description: Adobe's signature brand colour, used as a precise accent on black, white and grey foundations; its colour value and the places it may be used are library knowledge.

resources.label: Adobe Wordmark
resources.description: The spelled-out Adobe logotype, Adobe's primary brand identifier, used wherever no other Adobe identifier is present.

resources.label: Adobe Advertising
resources.description: Adobe Advertising is Adobe's independent ad platform that unifies and automates media, data, audiences, and creative across paid search, display, video, connected TV, audio, and native channels to deliver and optimize connected advertising experiences.

resources.label: Adobe Advertising Creative
resources.description: Adobe Advertising Creative is Adobe's ad serving and creative personalization solution for creating, managing, and optimizing dynamic display ad creatives, powering personalized experiences across Advertising DSP campaigns.

resources.label: Adobe Advertising DSP
resources.description: Adobe Advertising DSP is the demand-side platform within Adobe Advertising that lets advertisers plan, buy, and optimize display, video, audio, native, and connected TV inventory using advanced first-party audience segmentation, cross-device solutions, media quality controls, and integrations with Adobe Analytics and other Adobe Experience Cloud services.

resources.label: Adobe Advertising Search, Social, & Commerce
resources.description: Adobe Advertising Search, Social, & Commerce is Adobe Advertising's application for managing and optimizing search, shopping, social, audience network, and Performance Max campaigns across networks, combining portfolio-based ad management with intelligent forecasting and targeted, data-optimized delivery.

resources.label: AEM Onboarding Agent
resources.description: AEM Onboarding Agent is an Agent Orchestrator-powered onboarding capability for Experience Manager Assets, accessible via Coworker Chat and AI Assistant, that guides users through end-to-end DAM setup by orchestrating skills to propose and create folder hierarchies, tag taxonomies and metadata schemas and to configure bulk imports and search.

resources.label: Adobe Aero
resources.description: Adobe's former all-in-one augmented-reality authoring and viewing application for building and sharing interactive AR experiences from 2D and 3D assets, discontinued on iOS, Android, and Creative Cloud Desktop with access and content retrieval ending in late 2025.

resources.label: Adobe After Effects
resources.description: Adobe's motion-graphics, compositing, and visual-effects application for creating animated titles, character and logo animations, and complex composited scenes for film, television, video, and the web.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Platform Agent Orchestrator
resources.description: Adobe Experience Platform Agent Orchestrator is the agentic AI layer in Experience Platform that interprets natural-language goals, reasons through them, and coordinates purpose-built Adobe agents—deciding which to use, in what order, and how to combine their results. It works across Experience Cloud applications via interfaces like AI Assistant while inheriting Experience Platform's unified profiles, real-time data, and governance controls.

resources.label: Brand Intelligence
resources.description: Brand Intelligence is the Agentic Content Supply Chain pillar that encodes brand standards and safety constraints—tone, visual and copy rules, compliance policies, and performance learnings—so agents can generate and select content that stays on-brand and within human-defined guardrails.

resources.label: Agentic Content Supply Chain
resources.description: The Agentic Content Supply Chain is Adobe's domain layer and workflow/data model for automating the end-to-end marketing content lifecycle—intake, planning, creative production, activation, and measurement—across any organization, running on CX Enterprise Coworker as the AI agent runtime and orchestration engine, with human guardrails for compliance and high-risk decisions.

resources.label: Agentic Orchestration
resources.description: Agentic Orchestration is the Agentic Content Supply Chain pillar where CX Enterprise Coworker's orchestration engine and agent runtime coordinate when and how agents execute workflow steps across production lines, enforcing sequencing, handoffs, and guardrails.

resources.label: AI Assistant
resources.description: AI Assistant is a generative-AI conversational interface embedded in Adobe Experience Platform and CX Enterprise applications such as Real-Time CDP, Journey Optimizer, Customer Journey Analytics, AEM, Target, and Workfront, where it answers product and operational questions in natural language. It also fronts specialized agents (for example Audience Agent, Journey Agent, Product Support Agent and Data Insights Agent), allowing users to trigger agentic workflows through a single assistant.

resources.label: AI-first applications
resources.description: In CX Enterprise, AI-first applications are purpose-built products that embed generative and agentic AI directly into their workflows, drawing on Experience Platform Agents via Agent Orchestrator; they are packaged and licensed as distinct applications or capabilities depending on the specific product.

resources.label: AI Workflows
resources.description: AI Workflows is the Agentic Content Supply Chain pillar that defines reusable, agent-powered workflow playbooks across the full content lifecycle—intake, planning, creation, approvals, activation, and measurement—so marketing motions can run as consistent, automated production lines.

resources.label: Adobe Analytics
resources.description: Adobe's web and app analytics application — collecting, segmenting and reporting digital behaviour such as traffic, conversion and pathing, with Analysis Workspace as its analysis surface.

resources.label: Analytics for Advertising
resources.description: Analytics for Advertising is a bi-directional integration between Adobe Advertising (DSP, Search, Social, & Commerce) and Adobe Analytics that sends onsite engagement and conversion data into Adobe Advertising for optimization, while returning impression, click, and cost data to Analytics for unified reporting. When combined with Customer Journey Analytics, the same data powers cross-channel visualizations and journey analysis in CJA.

resources.label: Adobe Animate
resources.description: Adobe's 2D vector animation and interactive-content application with a timeline-based authoring environment for creating ads, games, apps and immersive experiences. It publishes to multiple formats including HTML5 Canvas, WebGL, video and Adobe AIR/Flash so animations can run across devices and platforms.

resources.label: Asset Management
resources.description: Asset Management is the third Content Supply Chain phase, where content is reviewed and approved for brand, legal, and accessibility standards, then stored, organized, and tagged in a DAM with rights and renditions so teams can discover, reuse, and distribute approved assets efficiently.

resources.label: Audience Agent
resources.description: Adobe's audience-management agent in Real-Time CDP and Journey Optimizer that lets practitioners explore, understand and manage audiences in natural language — surfacing inventory, detecting size changes and duplicates, and retrieving audience sizes.

resources.label: AI Assistant for Audiences
resources.description: In Adobe Real-Time CDP, AI Assistant for Audiences and the Audience Agent provide AI-driven audience capabilities: using natural language, marketers can estimate audience size, monitor and explain significant audience-size changes, forecast audience growth, and define goal-oriented audiences. These audience insights and forecasting features are surfaced through AI Assistant and grounded in Real-Time CDP's audience data and governance.

resources.label: Adobe Audience Manager
resources.description: Adobe Audience Manager is Adobe's data management platform that unifies first-party, second-party/partner and third-party, often pseudonymous, audience data to build and manage marketable segments for activation across advertising and other digital channels.

resources.label: Audio Overview
resources.description: In Acrobat's PDF Spaces, Audio Overview is an AI-generated spoken summary block used in shared spaces to let recipients listen to key highlights of the documents instead of reading, as part of a guided experience alongside files, notes, and the AI Assistant.

resources.label: Adobe Audition
resources.description: Adobe's audio recording, editing, mixing and restoration application — waveform and multitrack workflows for podcast, video and broadcast sound.

resources.label: Adobe Brand Concierge
resources.description: Adobe Brand Concierge is a brand-owned, AI-powered conversational experience that grounds interactions in approved first-party content to help visitors discover products, compare options, get answers, and receive guided recommendations across B2C and B2B journeys. It supports multimodal (text, voice, image) interactions, AI-to-human handoff, and deep integrations with Adobe Experience Platform and Adobe Experience Manager for governed, marketing-managed experiences.

resources.label: Brand Experience Agent
resources.description: Brand Experience Agent in Adobe Experience Manager automates high-effort, high-volume experience work by combining Experience Modernization (site migration to cloud-ready Edge Delivery Services), Experience Production (content and forms updates and communications), and Development Agent (Cloud Manager pipeline troubleshooting and operational support) so brands can modernize, update, and troubleshoot digital experiences faster with less manual effort.

resources.label: Brand Governance Agent
resources.description: Brand Governance/Governance Agent in Adobe Experience Manager safeguards brand integrity and compliance by automatically checking content, assets, and pages against brand and customer policies and by managing permissions and DRM, enforcing security, regulatory, and usage rules so experiences remain on-brand and compliant at scale.

resources.label: Adobe Brand Intelligence
resources.description: Adobe Brand Intelligence is GenStudio for Performance Marketing's governance and validation layer that evaluates human-created and AI-generated content against brand guidelines, channel rules, accessibility, and legal/regulatory standards, assigning compliance scores and flagging issues. It also powers skills like Validate and Instruct to Assemble/Adapt to assemble and adapt on-brand content variants at scale using continuously updated brand rules and feedback.

resources.label: Brand Visibility
resources.description: CX Enterprise's pillar for making a brand visible, trusted and chosen across AI surfaces and owned channels, and for optimising web experiences for both human and agentic traffic.

resources.label: Adobe Brand Voice
resources.description: The voice in which Adobe speaks in its own customer-facing words — narrative spines, claims, visible copy, speaker notes, marketing and learning content — as distinct from the product names and trademarks governed by Adobe's product taxonomy.

resources.label: Adobe Bridge
resources.description: Adobe Bridge is a powerful desktop creative asset manager that lets users preview, organize, batch-process, and enrich files with metadata, ratings, and keywords, while integrating with Creative Cloud apps, Adobe Stock Contributor, and Adobe Portfolio workflows.

resources.label: Adobe Campaign
resources.description: Adobe's cross-channel campaign application for planning, executing and measuring outbound campaigns — email at the core, with direct mail, SMS and push.

resources.label: Adobe Captivate
resources.description: Adobe's eLearning authoring application for building interactive, responsive courses, simulations and software demonstrations that publish to learning-management systems.

resources.label: Adobe Capture
resources.description: Adobe Capture is a mobile app for iOS and Android that turns photos into reusable creative ingredients—color themes, shapes, patterns, type, materials, and brushes—saving them to Creative Cloud Libraries for use across desktop and mobile apps.

resources.label: Adobe Acrobat Analyzer API
resources.description: Analyzer in Acrobat Studio is a GenAI document-intelligence capability for Acrobat and Acrobat Sign that provides REST APIs to upload contracts and other documents, extract structured, cited attributes (such as terms and clauses), search and filter across large collections, and integrate those insights into enterprise workflows.

resources.label: Catalog Service in Adobe Experience Platform
resources.description: Experience Platform's system of record for dataset metadata, lineage and location that other platform services read to find data.

resources.label: Adobe Character Animator
resources.description: Adobe Character Animator is an Emmy Award-winning 2D animation application that combines real-time live motion capture with multi-track recording to control layered puppets from Photoshop or Illustrator, using webcam, microphone, keyboard, mouse, and touch input for expressive animation and automatic lip-sync.

resources.label: ChatGPT Ads
resources.description: ChatGPT Ads in GenStudio for Performance Marketing lets marketers generate on-brand ChatGPT ad variants, run built-in brand and channel checks, route them through review and approval, and then publish them to OpenAI Ads Manager in an off state so media teams control final go-live inside ChatGPT Ads Manager.

resources.label: Adobe ColdFusion
resources.description: Adobe ColdFusion is a rapid web application development platform and server that uses the tag-based ColdFusion Markup Language (CFML) to build and deploy dynamic, data-driven websites, APIs, and enterprise web applications.

resources.label: Adobe ColdFusion Builder
resources.description: Adobe's former integrated development environment for building ColdFusion applications.

resources.label: Adobe Color
resources.description: Adobe's colour application for creating, exploring and saving palettes and themes usable across Creative Cloud applications.

resources.label: Adobe Commerce
resources.description: Adobe Commerce is a composable, cloud-native ecommerce platform for building and operating global, multi-brand B2C and B2B storefronts that deliver personalized, highly responsive shopping experiences, with core services for catalog and pricing, checkout and order management, and extensive APIs and extensions for custom commerce logic.

resources.label: Adobe Commerce as a Cloud Service
resources.description: Adobe Commerce as a Cloud Service is the fully managed SaaS edition of Adobe Commerce, where Adobe operates the core application and infrastructure, delivers continuous updates, and merchants extend functionality through APIs and Adobe Developer App Builder; its default storefront is powered by Edge Delivery Services, with optional headless deployments using third-party storefronts.

resources.label: Adobe Commerce Optimizer
resources.description: Adobe Commerce Optimizer is a high-performance, headless storefront and merchandising layer in the Commerce family that ingests catalog data from any source, defines business catalog views and policies, and uses AI-driven search, recommendations, success metrics, and testing to optimize storefront experiences while leaving the transactional commerce backend in place.

resources.label: Compress PDF
resources.description: Compress PDF is an Acrobat Document Cloud tool that reduces PDF file size using configurable compression levels, available both as an online service and through "Compress PDF" and "Optimize PDF" actions in Acrobat desktop and web.

resources.label: Adobe Connect
resources.description: Adobe Connect is a virtual training and webinar platform that provides persistent, customizable online rooms for interactive webinars, virtual classrooms, and meetings, with rich collaboration tools and recording.

resources.label: Content Advisor Agent
resources.description: Content Advisor Agent is Adobe's AI content-discovery and optimization agent that helps teams quickly find the right assets, content fragments, forms, and pages across AEM using natural-language prompts, and can generate channel-ready image variations from source assets to accelerate campaigns and reuse across Adobe and non-Adobe applications.

resources.label: Adobe Content Analytics
resources.description: Adobe Content Analytics is an AI-assisted content-performance application built on Adobe Experience Platform and delivered through Customer Journey Analytics that derives attributes such as objects, scenes, colors, tone, and messaging from web and mobile experiences, then connects them to behavioral data to explain which content drives engagement and revenue and why.

resources.label: Content & Commerce
resources.description: Adobe Experience Cloud's product category for managing and delivering content and commerce experiences — content management, digital asset management, forms, signage, technical documentation, storefronts and learning.

resources.label: Content Aware Fill
resources.description: The Photoshop and After Effects capability that fills a removed region by synthesising from the surrounding pixels of the same image — sampling the image itself rather than a generative model.

resources.label: Content Discovery Agent
resources.description: Content Discovery Agent is part of AEM's Content Advisor Agent and delivers unified conversational discovery across Assets, Content Fragments, Sites pages and Adaptive Forms, using natural-language prompts to return curated, approved content with metadata and Dynamic Media delivery URLs ready for reuse in other applications.

resources.label: Content Fragments in Adobe Experience Manager
resources.description: Experience Manager's structured, presentation-independent content authored against a content model and delivered through APIs, including GraphQL, to any channel — the unit of headless content.

resources.label: Content Optimization Agent
resources.description: Content Optimization Agent is an AEM-focused Experience Platform agent within Content Advisor that interprets natural-language intent to prepare and adapt images and video for different channels—generating optimized renditions via Dynamic Media and returning ready-to-use delivery URLs for web, mobile, email, social and other experiences.

resources.label: Content Production Agent
resources.description: Content Production Agent in GenStudio for Performance Marketing is a conversational, on-brand content-production agent that takes teams from brief to multi-asset content and activation, streamlining ideation, evaluation and generation of campaign-ready emails, ads and other assets while enforcing brand alignment.

resources.label: Content Supply Chain
resources.description: Adobe's Content Supply Chain is an end-to-end business process for marketing campaigns and personalized experiences, framed as five building blocks—Workflow & Planning, Creation & Production, Asset Management, Delivery & Activation, and Reporting & Insights—that connect strategy, execution, and measurement and focus on streamlining, governing, and optimizing enterprise content operations.

resources.label: Content Supply Chain
resources.description: CX Enterprise's pillar of a unified platform on GenStudio for planning, creating, managing, activating and measuring content at scale, from a foundational to an agentic content supply chain.

resources.label: Conversational Experience
resources.description: Conversational Experience is the Agentic Content Supply Chain pillar that provides the hybrid, conversational UI—across GenStudio and CX Enterprise Coworker surfaces—through which people direct agents, review work, and collaborate with the automated content supply chain.

resources.label: Adobe Corporate Visual Style
resources.description: The recognisable visual character of Adobe's corporate brand — colour behaviour, typographic character, imagery point of view, motion and video feel, and the treatment of its marks — applied to Adobe-branded decks, documents, videos and visual assets. It is a style, not a production design system, and is distinct from Spectrum, Adobe's design system for product interfaces.

resources.label: Creation & Production
resources.description: Creation & Production is the second Content Supply Chain phase, where content ideas become actual assets—copy, design, video, templates, and modular components—produced at scale (increasingly with generative AI) so they can be adapted and reused across channels and experiences.

resources.label: Adobe Creative Cloud
resources.description: Adobe's product family of creative applications and services for image, video, design, illustration, 3D and audio work, licensed as a subscription.

resources.label: Creative Cloud Libraries
resources.description: Creative Cloud Libraries are cloud-based shared libraries of design assets—such as colors, color themes, character styles, graphics, text, brushes, and logos—that keep brand elements consistent across apps like Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, XD, Capture, and even Microsoft Office. They support linked assets and collaboration so edits to a library item update everywhere it's used, helping teams maintain consistent design across projects.

resources.label: Adobe Creative Cloud mobile app
resources.description: Adobe's former Creative Cloud mobile hub for iOS and Android that let users manage and share Creative Cloud files and Libraries, browse and install apps, access tutorials, fonts and synced assets, and back up device content to Creative Cloud.

resources.label: Creativity & Productivity
resources.description: Creativity & Productivity (C&P), formerly Digital Media, is Adobe's business unit for Creative Cloud, Document Cloud, and 3D & immersive solutions such as Substance 3D and Aero, serving creators, business professionals, and consumers.

resources.label: CTV Ads
resources.description: CTV Ads in GenStudio for Performance Marketing provide a generative-AI, scene-based workflow to create on-brand connected TV spots, including AI-generated scenes, music, and voiceover, refine them, and export publisher-ready CTV video that can be saved to Content and used in downstream CTV buying and activation workflows.

resources.label: Customer Engagement
resources.description: CX Enterprise's pillar for orchestrating the customer lifecycle — journey orchestration, audience management, decisioning and analytics — on Experience Platform and its applications.

resources.label: Customer Experience Orchestration
resources.description: Customer Experience Orchestration (CXO) is Adobe's enterprise business unit formerly known as Digital Experience, responsible for Adobe Experience Cloud and Adobe Experience Platform and focused on end-to-end customer-experience and marketing solutions for businesses.

resources.label: Adobe Customer Journey Analytics
resources.description: Experience Platform's cross-channel analytics application — joining online and offline event data into a single journey view queried in Analysis Workspace.

resources.label: Adobe Customer Journey Analytics B2B Edition
resources.description: The B2B edition of Customer Journey Analytics — account-level journey analysis that rolls person activity up to buying groups and accounts.

resources.label: Customer Journeys
resources.description: Adobe Experience Cloud's product category for orchestrating and personalising customer engagement — journeys, campaigns, testing and personalisation, and marketing automation.

resources.label: Administration and Governance
resources.description: An Adobe customer learning journey in operating and governing the platform: configuration, permissions, data governance and release management.

resources.label: Adoption and Daily Use
resources.description: An Adobe customer learning journey in which the product becomes the default way of working and core use cases are executed to a good standard.

resources.label: Implementation and Integration
resources.description: An Adobe customer learning journey in building the product into the customer's architecture: APIs, data, identity and extensions.

resources.label: Onboarding and First Value
resources.description: An Adobe customer learning journey from contract to first realised value: orientation, initial setup and the first live use case.

resources.label: Value Expansion and Maturity
resources.description: An Adobe customer learning journey in measuring outcomes, maturing usage and expanding into new use cases and capabilities.

resources.label: Business Practitioner
resources.description: An Adobe customer learner persona that uses the Adobe product in their daily work to produce business output – marketers, analysts, campaign and journey managers, content authors. Its core learning needs are: apply the product effectively in the daily workflow; execute core use cases (campaigns, journeys, content, analysis) to a good standard; interpret results and optimise; absorb new features that change how the daily job is done.

resources.label: Executive Sponsor
resources.description: An Adobe customer learner persona for the senior customer leader accountable for the investment and its value case, who sponsors adoption across their organisation and owns the renewal and expansion decision context. Its core learning needs are: value narrative and business-case fluency for the Adobe investment; outcome and value measurement (what good looks like, how it is evidenced); organisational adoption sponsorship (what to mandate, fund and remove as blockers); roadmap and capability awareness at decision altitude.

resources.label: Implementer / Integrator
resources.description: An Adobe customer learner persona that builds, integrates and extends the Adobe product within the customer's architecture – customer-side developers, architects and data engineers (and equivalent partner delivery roles working in the customer's environment). Its core learning needs are: implement and integrate the product within the existing architecture; APIs, SDKs and extensibility patterns; data architecture, ingestion and identity design; troubleshooting, performance and upgrade paths.

resources.label: Platform Administrator
resources.description: An Adobe customer learner persona that operates and governs the deployed Adobe product day to day – configuration, users and permissions, data hygiene, governance and release readiness. Its core learning needs are: configure and govern the platform to organisational policy; user, permission and licence administration; data governance, privacy and consent operations; release/feature-change management and internal support.

resources.label: Business Analyst
resources.description: A customer-side role in the business family of Adobe's customer crosswalk responsible for analysis, reporting and optimisation using product data; it resolves to the Business Practitioner customer learner persona.

resources.label: Content Author
resources.description: A customer-side role in the business family of Adobe's customer crosswalk responsible for content creation, assembly and publishing workflows; it resolves to the Business Practitioner customer learner persona.

resources.label: Customer Data Engineer
resources.description: A customer-side role in the technical family of Adobe's customer crosswalk responsible for data ingestion, identity, schema and pipeline work feeding the platform; it resolves to the Implementer / Integrator customer learner persona.

resources.label: Customer Developer
resources.description: A customer-side role in the technical family of Adobe's customer crosswalk that builds and maintains integrations, extensions and implementations against Adobe APIs/SDKs; it resolves to the Implementer / Integrator customer learner persona.

resources.label: Customer Executive Sponsor
resources.description: A customer-side role in the leadership family of Adobe's customer crosswalk responsible for the value case, funding, and executive sponsorship of adoption; it resolves to the Executive Sponsor customer learner persona.

resources.label: Marketing Practitioner
resources.description: A customer-side role in the business family of Adobe's customer crosswalk responsible for campaign/journey planning and execution in the product; it resolves to the Business Practitioner customer learner persona.

resources.label: Platform Admin
resources.description: A customer-side role in the technical family of Adobe's customer crosswalk responsible for day-to-day platform operation: configuration, users/permissions, governance, release readiness; it resolves to the Platform Administrator customer learner persona.

resources.label: Customer Program Owner
resources.description: A customer-side role in the leadership family of Adobe's customer crosswalk responsible for operational ownership of the adoption program and centre of excellence; it resolves to the Executive Sponsor customer learner persona. It may warrant a distinct adoption-champion persona if its need-by-depth signature diverges from executive sponsorship.

resources.label: Customer Solution Architect
resources.description: A customer-side role in the technical family of Adobe's customer crosswalk responsible for architecture decisions for how the Adobe product sits in the customer's estate; it resolves to the Implementer / Integrator customer learner persona.

resources.label: All Customer Technical
resources.description: An Adobe customer targeting group that selects customer personas doing technical work in or on the platform; it is a targeting convenience that expands to its member personas and carries no learner profile of its own.

resources.label: All Customer Personas
resources.description: An Adobe customer targeting group that selects every customer learner persona in this model; it is a targeting convenience that expands to its member personas and carries no learner profile of its own.

resources.label: Adobe CX Enterprise
resources.description: Adobe CX Enterprise is Adobe's unified, agentic system and commercial framing for its customer-experience portfolio, replacing Adobe Experience Cloud in market and organizing Brand Visibility, Customer Engagement, and Content Supply Chain solutions on Adobe Experience Platform and Agent Orchestrator without introducing a new SKU.

resources.label: CX Enterprise Agents
resources.description: The group of purpose-built AI agents that live inside existing CX Enterprise applications, are reached through Agent Orchestrator and draw on AI credits.

resources.label: Adobe CX Enterprise Coworker
resources.description: Adobe CX Enterprise Coworker is the persistent, goal-oriented agentic engine for CX Enterprise that turns business objectives into multi-step workflows across Real-Time CDP, Journey Optimizer, AEM, Workfront, and other systems, planning, executing, and validating the work with approvals, governance, long-term memory, and business context so teams can automate customer-experience workflows end-to-end.

resources.label: Data Access API in Adobe Experience Platform
resources.description: Adobe Experience Platform Data Access API is a RESTful interface that provides raw and XDM-level access to ingested Data Lake datasets for discoverability and export to external tools, but it is now deprecated and new implementations should use dataset export destinations in Adobe Experience Platform instead.

resources.label: Data Engineering Agent
resources.description: Data Engineering Agent is an Experience Platform data-management agent that accelerates onboarding and ongoing data operations by helping define schemas and mappings, orchestrate ingestion, and run AI-powered data validation and quality checks across fields and datasets to improve decision-making.

resources.label: Data Governance
resources.description: Adobe Experience Platform Data Governance is a service and framework of data usage labels, usage policies, and policy enforcement that lets you classify data at connection, dataset, and field level and control which marketing actions on that data are allowed, automatically detecting and preventing policy-violating activations and other data operations.

resources.label: Data Insights Agent
resources.description: Adobe's analytics agent in Customer Journey Analytics that answers plain-language questions about the data and builds the matching visualisations and tables, grounded in the organisation's configured data views.

resources.label: Data Insights & Audiences
resources.description: Adobe Experience Cloud's product category for collecting and analysing customer data and building the audiences activated from it — analytics, customer data platform, audience management, measurement and advertising.

resources.label: Data Lake in Adobe Experience Platform
resources.description: The Adobe Experience Platform data lake is the primary data repository where all successfully ingested data is persisted as datasets, serving as both a staging area and long-term storage to support analytics, data science, Query Service, and downstream services such as Real-Time Customer Profile and activation.

resources.label: Data Prep in Adobe Experience Platform
resources.description: Adobe Experience Platform Data Prep is the mapping and transformation layer used in the ingestion process that lets data engineers map, transform, and validate source data to and from Experience Data Model (XDM) before it is written into datasets and used by downstream services.

resources.label: Dataflows in Adobe Experience Platform
resources.description: Dataflows are Flow Service–backed representations of data jobs that move data across Adobe Experience Platform—from source connectors into target datasets, through Identity Service and Real-Time Customer Profile, and out to destinations—while providing configurable orchestration and end-to-end monitoring.

resources.label: Datasets in Adobe Experience Platform
resources.description: In Adobe Experience Platform, a dataset is a storage and management construct in the data lake—typically a table with an XDM schema, rows, and metadata—that serves as the core unit of data persistence and is consumed by services such as Real-Time Customer Profile, Identity Service, Query Service, segmentation, and Destinations when the dataset is appropriately configured (for example, enabled for profile).

resources.label: Datastreams in Adobe Experience Platform
resources.description: Adobe Experience Platform Datastreams are Edge Network configurations that specify which Experience Cloud applications (such as Adobe Experience Platform, Analytics, Target, and Journey Optimizer) and event-forwarding endpoints receive each incoming payload and how that data is handled and stored in each product.

resources.label: Decisioning Service in Adobe Experience Platform
resources.description: Adobe's decisioning capability, delivered through Journey Optimizer, uses a central library of marketing offers and a decision engine that applies eligibility rules and ranking strategies against Real-Time Customer Profiles to select the best offer or experience in real time for channels such as email, web, mobile, and API-based experiences.

resources.label: Delivery & Activation
resources.description: The Content Supply Chain stage in which approved content is published and activated across channels and campaigns.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Platform Destinations Service
resources.description: Destinations in Adobe Experience Platform and Real-Time Customer Data Platform are pre-built integrations with downstream platforms (including advertising, email, cloud storage, analytics, social, and mobile) that seamlessly activate known and unknown audience and profile data from Real-Time Customer Profile, enforcing Data Governance labels and policies on what data can be exported.

resources.label: Adobe Developer Console
resources.description: Adobe Developer Console is Adobe's central developer hub where you create projects, add APIs and events, provision and manage credentials and OAuth flows, and configure integrations and webhooks against Adobe cloud services via Adobe I/O.

resources.label: Development Agent
resources.description: Development Agent is Adobe's AEM developer agent within Brand Experience Agent that helps traditional AEM Java-stack developers and administrators create, debug, deploy, and optimize code by managing Cloud Manager pipelines, analyzing failed build steps and logs to suggest fixes, configuring quiet hours and update-free periods, and troubleshooting replication issues such as blocked queues—all through AI Assistant.

resources.label: Digital Advertising, Learning & Publishing
resources.description: Digital Advertising, Learning & Publishing (D-ALP), formerly the Print & Publishing Business Unit, is Adobe's business unit for digital learning, technical communication, web-conferencing, and advertising products including Adobe Captivate, Adobe Learning Manager, Adobe Connect, Technical Communication Suite, and Adobe Advertising.

resources.label: Adobe Dimension
resources.description: Adobe's 3D design and scene-staging application for graphic designers to create photorealistic product mock-ups and brand visuals using 2D and 3D compositing. It focuses on arranging models, materials, lighting and cameras to render high-quality images without requiring full 3D modeling or animation workflows.

resources.label: Adobe Document Cloud
resources.description: Adobe Document Cloud is Adobe's portfolio for digital document productivity—creating, editing, reviewing, signing, and scanning PDFs—centered on Acrobat, Acrobat Sign, mobile apps like Adobe Scan, and cloud-based PDF services and integrations.

resources.label: Adobe Document Cloud Review Service
resources.description: The Adobe Document Cloud review service is the cloud service behind Acrobat's share-for-review workflows, enabling hosts to send personalized invitations or public links, collect and consolidate reviewer comments by a deadline, and track review activity across Acrobat desktop, Document Cloud on the web, and Acrobat Reader mobile.

resources.label: Adobe Document Generation API
resources.description: Adobe Document Generation API is a cloud service that dynamically merges JSON data into Word (DOCX) or HTML templates with conditional logic to generate PDF or Word documents such as contracts, invoices and sales proposals, often used to automate agreement workflows.

resources.label: Document H1 Red Underline
resources.description: The thin Adobe Red underline beneath H1-level headings that Adobe document templates call for — a document heading treatment, distinct from presentation-template chrome.

resources.label: Adobe Dreamweaver
resources.description: Adobe Dreamweaver is a comprehensive web design and development tool that combines a powerful visual design surface with a best-in-class code editor and robust site management, enabling web designers and front-end developers to design, code, and manage modern responsive websites in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and more.

resources.label: Adobe Dynamic Chat
resources.description: Adobe Dynamic Chat is Marketo Engage's native conversational marketing capability that uses AI-driven dialogues and conversational forms to capture and qualify visitors, schedule meetings on sales calendars, and add people into Marketo Engage programs and campaigns instead of relying on static forms.

resources.label: Dynamic Creative Optimization
resources.description: Dynamic Creative Optimization in Adobe Advertising Creative uses product and audience feeds, HTML5 and video ad templates, and a two-tier engine that combines rule-based targeting with machine-learning optimization to assemble and serve personalized ad variants in real time at scale.

resources.label: Experience Platform Edge Network Server API
resources.description: The Adobe Experience Platform Edge Network Server API is a secure, authenticated REST API for sending events from servers, IoT devices and other non-browser clients to the Platform Edge Network for data collection, personalization, advertising and marketing use cases, as a server-side alternative to the Web and Mobile SDKs.

resources.label: Experience Platform Edge Profile
resources.description: Edge profiles are lightweight projections of Real-Time Customer Profile replicated to the Adobe Experience Platform Edge Network via edge projections, providing high-throughput, low-latency access to profile attributes and audiences for real-time web and mobile personalization and offer decisioning.

resources.label: Enterprise Context
resources.description: Enterprise Context is the Agentic Content Supply Chain pillar that provides the unified campaign/program context—briefs, structured metadata, hierarchy, and audience/journey definitions—that agent workflows read and write so every action is grounded in a consistent marketing context.

resources.label: Event forwarding in Adobe Experience Platform
resources.description: Adobe Experience Platform Event Forwarding is the server-side data collection capability that runs rules on events received by the Edge Network to transform and enrich them, then forwards the resulting data to non-Adobe and other destinations without adding client-side weight or changing existing implementations.

resources.label: Adobe Exchange
resources.description: Adobe's marketplace for third-party apps, plug-ins and integrations that extend Creative Cloud, Document Cloud and Experience Cloud products.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Cloud
resources.description: Adobe Experience Cloud is Adobe's integrated portfolio of applications and services for understanding customers, managing content, and orchestrating journeys—organized into Content & Commerce, Data Insights & Audiences, Customer Journeys, and Marketing Workflow, all built on Adobe Experience Platform.

resources.label: Experience Cloud ID Service
resources.description: Experience Cloud ID Service (ECID) is an Experience Cloud identity service and tag extension that sets a common visitor identifier across Adobe Experience Cloud solutions; ECID values can be ingested into Adobe Experience Platform and used as one of the identifiers in the identity graph, but the service itself is not a native Adobe Experience Platform capability.

resources.label: Experience Data Model
resources.description: Experience Data Model (XDM) is Adobe's publicly documented specification and standardized framework for organizing customer experience data as schemas composed of a class and field groups, so data from different sources is represented consistently and can be unified, analyzed, and activated across Adobe Experience Platform and other systems.

resources.label: Experience Fragments in Adobe Experience Manager
resources.description: Experience Manager's reusable groups of components with layout — a complete piece of an experience placed across pages and channels so the same composed content is maintained once.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Manager
resources.description: Adobe's enterprise content management solution that unifies web and headless site management, digital asset management, forms, and digital signage so teams can author, manage, and deliver personalized experiences across web, mobile, and in-venue channels from one platform.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Manager Assets
resources.description: Experience Manager's digital asset management application — storing, tagging, governing and distributing approved assets at enterprise scale, with renditions for channel-ready delivery.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Manager Edge Delivery Services
resources.description: Adobe Experience Manager Edge Delivery Services is a composable set of services for AEM Sites that combines document-based and code-based authoring with a new edge-based publish tier and Adobe-managed CDN, enabling rapid development and delivery of high-performance, pre-rendered experiences.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Manager Forms
resources.description: Experience Manager's application for digital enrolment — adaptive forms and automated document communications connected to back-end workflows and e-signature.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Manager Guides
resources.description: Adobe Experience Manager Guides is an enterprise-grade, DITA-based component content management solution (CCMS) add-on to Adobe Experience Manager that provides native DITA support for structured authoring, review, reuse, translation, and multi-channel publishing of technical documentation.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Manager Screens
resources.description: Experience Manager's digital-signage application for authoring and operating in-venue screen experiences from the same content platform as web channels.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Manager Sites
resources.description: Experience Manager's web content-management application for authoring, managing and delivering websites, including headless delivery.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Manager Sites Optimizer
resources.description: Adobe Experience Manager Sites Optimizer is an AI-first companion application for AEM Sites that continuously analyzes site performance, discovery, engagement and site health, surfacing opportunities and preflight checks (including accessibility and Core Web Vitals) with recommended fixes across SEO, page speed and content issues.

resources.label: Experience Modernization Agent
resources.description: Experience Modernization Agent is Adobe's AI development and site-migration agent for Adobe Experience Manager Edge Delivery Services that onboards existing websites by automating site creation and migration, mapping pages to blocks, extracting design patterns, and generating Edge Delivery code, with the self-service Experience Modernization Console and AOE delivery model supporting ongoing block development and complex, production-ready migrations.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Platform
resources.description: Adobe's real-time data and decisioning base that standardizes customer data in XDM schemas, manages Real-Time Customer Profiles, audiences, and governance, and serves as the shared foundation for applications such as Adobe Real-Time Customer Data Platform, Adobe Journey Optimizer, and Customer Journey Analytics.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Platform Assurance
resources.description: Adobe Experience Platform Assurance is a debugging and validation tool—used primarily with the AEP Mobile SDK but also for web—that lets you inspect, proof, simulate, and validate SDK events, Places Service location signals, and other Experience Cloud data as they flow into and out of the Platform Edge Network.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Platform Auditor
resources.description: The former standalone system that graded Experience Cloud implementations, whose tests now run in the Experience Platform Debugger.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Platform Data Collection
resources.description: Adobe Experience Platform Data Collection is the family of data-capture and routing technologies—including Web and Mobile SDKs, Tags, Datastreams, Event Forwarding, the Edge Network Server API, Assurance, and Debugger—for collecting event data client- and server-side into the Edge Network and sending it on to Adobe and non-Adobe destinations.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Platform Debugger
resources.description: Adobe Experience Platform Debugger is a Chrome (and Firefox) browser extension that examines your web pages and helps you debug and validate Adobe Experience Cloud implementations—including Web SDK, Tags, Analytics, Target, Audience Manager—and the browser-side requests sent to the Platform Edge Network.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Platform Edge Network
resources.description: Adobe Experience Platform Edge Network is a globally distributed, fast routing network that receives XDM event data from Web SDK, Mobile SDK, and the Edge Network Server API and, via datastreams, distributes it in product-specific formats to Adobe applications and other destinations, underpinning client-side tags, server-side event forwarding, and real-time experiences such as decisioning.

resources.label: Experience Production Agent
resources.description: Experience Production Agent is Adobe's production-focused AEM agent within Brand Experience Agent that automates high-effort, high-volume updates across sites and forms—updating existing pages, content fragments, and forms and creating new forms and communications—so teams can keep experiences current without rebuilding content manually.

resources.label: Experimentation Agent
resources.description: Experimentation Agent in Journey Optimizer Experimentation Accelerator centralizes past and active experiments, summarizes results by audience, analyzes why certain creatives and treatments win, attributes performance to key factors, and proposes new high-impact tests and opportunities, including workflows that integrate with Adobe Target.

resources.label: Adobe Express
resources.description: Adobe Express is a web and mobile content-creation app with hundreds of thousands of templates and AI-powered tools for quickly creating social posts, graphics, videos, presentations, webpages, and other marketing assets, with templates and integrations available across Creative Cloud apps.

resources.label: Experience Cloud Unified Search
resources.description: Experience Cloud Unified Search is a global search feature in the Experience Cloud header that lets users find searchable business objects and entities and access Experience League help from a single, permission-aware search surface. It is currently available for Adobe Experience Platform and Adobe Journey Optimizer rather than spanning every Experience Platform application and asset type.

resources.label: Field Discovery Agent
resources.description: Field Discovery Agent is an AI-powered agent in Adobe Experience Platform that, both directly in AI Assistant and behind the scenes for agents such as Audience and Data Engineering, uses natural-language queries to return ranked XDM field suggestions with sample values, schema location and usage context to support segmentation, querying and other data workflows.

resources.label: Fill & Sign
resources.description: Fill & Sign is a Document Cloud tool that lets you fill in PDF forms and add your own signature and initials, available in Acrobat on desktop and web, Acrobat Reader, and a standalone mobile app; in Acrobat you can also route forms to others for e-signatures using related e-sign tools.

resources.label: Adobe Fill & Sign
resources.description: Adobe Fill & Sign is a free mobile app that lets you snap a picture of a paper or digital form, fill it out, sign with your finger or stylus, and send it from your phone or tablet, backed by the Document Cloud Fill & Sign service to sync forms and autofill data across devices.

resources.label: Adobe Firefly
resources.description: Adobe Firefly is Adobe's family of creative generative AI models and tools, available as an AI-powered web experience and integrated across Creative Cloud apps, for generating and editing images, text effects, vector graphics, video, and audio using commercially safe models trained on Adobe Stock and other licensed and public-domain content.

resources.label: Firefly AI Assistant
resources.description: Firefly AI Assistant is Adobe's agentic creative orchestration layer—a conversational interface that understands what a creator wants to make, plans multi-step workflows across Firefly, Creative Cloud and partner generative models, then executes them while keeping assets editable in Firefly Boards and apps like Photoshop, Illustrator and Premiere.

resources.label: Adobe Firefly Boards
resources.description: Adobe Firefly Boards is a web-based, generative-first canvas that blends moodboarding and collaboration, letting teams generate, remix, and arrange images, text, and video on shared boards to explore, visualize, and present ideas together.

resources.label: Adobe Firefly Creative Production
resources.description: Adobe Firefly Creative Production is a no-code, enterprise creative-automation application that lets teams use Firefly to batch replace backgrounds, crop images, and color-grade thousands of files at once, producing consistent on-brand variations at scale.

resources.label: Adobe Firefly Custom Models
resources.description: Enterprise Firefly models trained on an organisation's own approved images—capturing brand styles, products, and characters—to generate on-brand text-to-image content in Adobe Firefly, Adobe Express, and Adobe GenStudio, with each custom model kept private to the organisation and not used to train Adobe's foundational Firefly models.

resources.label: Adobe Firefly Design Intelligence
resources.description: Adobe Firefly Design Intelligence (FDI) is an AI-powered design intelligence system delivered as a pair of Adobe Illustrator plug-ins that lets enterprise creative teams train StyleIDs capturing brand layout, visual, and verbal rules, then generate, adapt, and scale brand-compliant artboards and context-aware copy across campaigns and sizes.

resources.label: Adobe Firefly Foundry
resources.description: Adobe Firefly Foundry is a managed, cloud-hosted service in which Adobe AI/ML scientists and engineers research a customer's business, then build, train, deploy, and run bespoke multimodal generative models on that customer's IP, integrating them into Creative Cloud apps, Firefly Services APIs, and selected third-party workflows under strict IP protection and enterprise governance.

resources.label: Adobe Firefly Services
resources.description: Adobe Firefly Services (Firefly Creative Production for Enterprise) is an enterprise-only collection of generative and creative APIs—including Firefly image/video generation plus Photoshop, Lightroom, InDesign, audio/video and content-tagging services—that lets organizations automate high-volume, brand-safe content production such as variants, localization and asset refreshes via REST APIs.

resources.label: Firefly Video Model
resources.description: The Firefly generative video model that provides commercially safe text-to-video and image-to-video creation in the Firefly web app, trained only on content Adobe has permission to use—such as Adobe Stock and public-domain content where copyright has expired—and never on customer content.

resources.label: Adobe Fonts
resources.description: Adobe Fonts is a cloud font service included with Adobe subscriptions that provides a large library of fully licensed typefaces you add from fonts.adobe.com for use across Creative Cloud apps and the web, with no additional per-font fees for normal personal and commercial use.

resources.label: Adobe Frame.io
resources.description: Adobe Frame.io is a cloud-based review and collaboration platform that centralizes media sharing, frame-accurate time-stamped comments, version management, and Camera to Cloud workflows, integrating with Premiere Pro and other tools to connect production to post.

resources.label: Adobe FrameMaker
resources.description: Adobe's technical-authoring application for long, structured documents — XML and DITA authoring, templates and publishing to print, PDF and the web.

resources.label: Adobe Fresco
resources.description: Adobe Fresco is a free drawing and painting application designed for stylus and touch devices that combines vector and raster brushes with Live Brushes that behave like real watercolors and oils, plus modern tools such as motion and advanced selections for professional-grade digital art.

resources.label: Generate Podcast
resources.description: Generate Podcast (Acrobat Podcast) turns document or PDF Space content into AI-generated, two-host conversational podcasts in two formats: a shorter Highlights podcast (~6 minutes) and a longer Deep Dive podcast (~12 minutes). Users can generate and play these podcasts across Acrobat desktop, web, and mobile to review reports and complex topics on the go.

resources.label: Generative Expand
resources.description: Photoshop's Firefly-powered capability that extends an image beyond its original borders, generating matching content to fill the enlarged canvas.

resources.label: Generative Fill
resources.description: Generative Fill in Photoshop is a non-destructive generative-AI feature that lets you replace or add content inside a selection using a text prompt or automatic context-based fill, synthesizing new pixels that blend with the surrounding image. It supports Firefly and partner models (such as FLUX and Gemini) so generated content matches the scene's lighting, perspective, and texture.

resources.label: Adobe GenStudio
resources.description: Adobe GenStudio is Adobe's generative-AI-first content supply chain platform, with GenStudio for Performance Marketing providing an end-to-end pipeline to plan, create, activate, and measure on-brand marketing content, built on integrations with Workfront, Experience Manager Assets, Firefly/Express, Content Analytics, and Adobe Experience Platform.

resources.label: Adobe GenStudio for Commerce Media Networks
resources.description: GenStudio's application that lets a retailer's commerce media network enable brands to launch on-brand advertising campaigns, building advertiser profiles and creative assets from product listings and activating them in the retailer's ad network.

resources.label: Adobe GenStudio for Content Marketing
resources.description: GenStudio's application that applies the GenStudio creation-and-activation pipeline to content-marketing assets — briefs to on-brand marketing content — rather than to paid-media ads.

resources.label: Adobe GenStudio for Performance Marketing
resources.description: Adobe GenStudio for Performance Marketing is a generative-AI-first application that gives marketing teams a self-service pipeline to plan, create, activate, and measure on-brand ads and emails across paid media, social, and email, with enterprise guardrails for brand and policy compliance.

resources.label: Adobe GenStudio
resources.description: Adobe GenStudio is a GenAI-first, self-contained application and underlying platform that gives marketers a complete, self-service content supply chain—planning, creating, managing, activating, and measuring on-brand campaign content in one experience. It streamlines marketing asset production with generative AI, workflow, asset management, activation, and performance insights under enterprise-grade governance and brand controls.

resources.label: GenStudio Services
resources.description: GenStudio Services (GenStudio Experience API) is GenStudio's public, read-only REST API that lets partner and enterprise applications list and filter approved experiences, retrieve full experience metadata, templates and short-lived asset delivery URLs, so GenStudio content can flow programmatically into external channels and workflows using Adobe IMS OAuth server-to-server credentials.

resources.label: Identity graph in Adobe Experience Platform
resources.description: Identity Graph in Adobe Experience Platform Identity Service is a near-real-time map of relationships between stitched identities—such as device IDs, hashed emails, and CRM IDs—within a private graph per organization. It bridges fragmented identifiers across devices and systems so Real-Time Customer Profile, using merge policies and governance rules, can assemble comprehensive views of each customer.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Platform Identity Service
resources.description: Adobe Experience Platform Identity Service is the identity service that uses identity namespaces and identity graphs to bridge customer identifiers across devices and systems; its identity graphs are leveraged by Real-Time Customer Profile to stitch disparate profile fragments into unified profiles, and it is distinct from the Experience Cloud ID/Visitor ID Service.

resources.label: Adobe Illustrator
resources.description: Adobe's professional vector-graphics application — logos, icons, illustration and type built from scalable paths rather than pixels.

resources.label: Adobe Illustrator (web)
resources.description: Illustrator on the web (Beta) is a browser-based Illustrator experience that lets you create and edit vector graphics using essential shape, path, typography, color, and collaboration tools, working with Creative Cloud-synced documents from anywhere.

resources.label: Adobe InCopy
resources.description: Adobe's professional writing and copy-editing application with track-changes and copy-fitting tools that lets writers and editors work inside linked InDesign layouts in parallel with designers as part of a collaborative editorial workflow.

resources.label: Adobe InDesign
resources.description: Adobe's professional page-layout and desktop-publishing application for print and digital documents — books, magazines, brochures and interactive PDFs.

resources.label: Journey Agent
resources.description: Adobe's journey-orchestration agent in Journey Optimizer that builds journeys from natural-language prompts, analyses fallout, detects scheduling and audience conflicts and proposes adjustments before publication.

resources.label: Adobe Journey Optimizer
resources.description: Experience Platform's journey application — orchestrating and delivering individual customer journeys, triggered messages, campaigns and offers across email, mobile and web from the Real-Time Customer Profile.

resources.label: Adobe Journey Optimizer B2B Edition
resources.description: Adobe Journey Optimizer B2B Edition is the buying-group-aware edition of Journey Optimizer that uses Adobe Experience Platform and Real-Time CDP B2B data to orchestrate account and person journeys for B2B, managing buying groups and activating coordinated engagement—including actions that integrate with Marketo Engage.

resources.label: Adobe Journey Optimizer Experimentation Accelerator
resources.description: Adobe Journey Optimizer Experimentation Accelerator is an AI-first experimentation application that runs alongside Adobe Journey Optimizer and/or Adobe Target, centralizing past and active experiments, surfacing AI-driven insights and growth opportunities, and streamlining the design and monitoring of adaptive, always-on tests.

resources.label: Adobe Journey Optimizer Loyalty
resources.description: Adobe Journey Optimizer Loyalty is an add-on to Adobe Journey Optimizer that lets brands design, deploy, and optimize gamified loyalty challenges, unifying loyalty signals in Adobe Experience Platform and ingesting data from external loyalty platforms, while AI-powered insights and a Loyalty Agent help orchestrate member experiences across channels.

resources.label: Adobe Learning Manager
resources.description: Adobe's cloud learning-management application for delivering and tracking training for customers, partners and employees.

resources.label: Adobe Lightroom
resources.description: Adobe's cloud-centric photo editing and organisation application, syncing originals and edits across desktop, web and mobile.

resources.label: Adobe Lightroom Classic
resources.description: Adobe's desktop-centric, file-based photo-workflow application — local cataloguing, batch editing and print output for photographers who keep originals on disk.

resources.label: Adobe Lightroom (web)
resources.description: The browser surface of Lightroom for viewing, culling and editing synced photos from any machine.

resources.label: LLM Optimization Agent
