resources.description: Adobe Brand Visibility (formerly LLM Optimizer) is a generative AI-first application for Generative Engine Optimization that helps brands understand how they show up in AI-generated answers, track brand presence, agentic and referral traffic, and use prescriptive content recommendations and automated fixes (including Optimize at Edge) to improve visibility, accuracy, and influence in AI-driven search.

resources.label: Adobe Brand Visibility
resources.description: Adobe Brand Visibility is an end-to-end AI visibility and optimization platform that helps brands understand, improve, and measure how they are discovered and represented across both traditional search and AI-driven experiences. It combines Adobe's LLM Optimizer with SEMrush intelligence to deliver GEO dashboards and workflows that turn visibility insights into live CMS and edge optimizations and measured business outcomes.

resources.label: Loyalty Agent
resources.description: Loyalty Agent is an AI-powered assistant in Adobe Journey Optimizer Loyalty that lets marketers manage loyalty challenges and analyze program performance via natural language—surfacing KPIs, anomalies and next-best recommendations and, over time, supporting challenge creation, editing and orchestration through Agent Orchestrator.

resources.label: Adobe Marketing Agent
resources.description: Adobe Marketing Agent is an Experience Platform agent that surfaces Operational Insights, Customer Journey Analytics data insights, Audience Agent and Journey Agent capabilities directly inside Microsoft 365 Copilot, so marketers can ask natural-language questions about audiences, journeys and campaign performance in Teams, Word, PowerPoint and Excel without leaving their flow of work.

resources.label: Marketing Workflow
resources.description: Adobe Experience Cloud's product category for planning and managing marketing work — projects, workflows, approvals and resourcing.

resources.label: Adobe Marketo Engage
resources.description: Adobe Marketo Engage is Adobe's marketing automation platform for lead-based and account-based marketing that lets marketers orchestrate multi-channel campaigns (email, web, mobile, events), manage and nurture leads with scoring and segmentation, and sync engagement and revenue data with CRM systems such as Salesforce and Microsoft Dynamics.

resources.label: Adobe Marketo Measure
resources.description: Adobe Marketo Measure is Adobe's B2B marketing attribution solution that connects to CRM and marketing platforms to track marketing touchpoints across channels, apply multi-touch attribution models, and measure pipeline and revenue ROI, with data that can enrich analytics and reporting tools.

resources.label: Adobe Media Encoder
resources.description: Adobe's media-processing, transcoding, and rendering application for ingesting, transcoding, creating proxies, and outputting audio and video to a wide range of delivery formats, tightly integrated with Adobe Premiere, After Effects, and other Creative Cloud apps for background encoding workflows.

resources.label: Merchant Productivity Agent
resources.description: Merchant Productivity Agent is an AI-powered assistant in Adobe Commerce that helps merchants operate, optimize and grow their business by using natural-language prompts to run merchandising and operational tasks, explore store and catalog data, surface opportunities or risks, and execute agentic actions across commerce workflows.

resources.label: Adobe Mix Modeler
resources.description: Adobe Mix Modeler is an Adobe Experience Cloud application built on Adobe Experience Platform and powered by Adobe Sensei that uses a combination of marketing mix modeling and multi-touch attribution to measure campaign performance and forecast and optimize marketing spend across paid, earned, and owned channels.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Platform Mobile SDK
resources.description: Adobe Experience Platform Mobile SDK is a modular mobile SDK that sends app data in XDM format to the Adobe Experience Platform Edge Network and integrates with solutions such as Analytics, Campaign, Audience Manager and Target to power real-time personalization, consent management and end-to-end engagement in mobile applications.

resources.label: Adobe Muse
resources.description: Adobe's former web-design application for building websites visually without writing code.

resources.label: Offer Decisioning
resources.description: Offer Decisioning is an application service integrated with Adobe Experience Platform and Adobe Journey Optimizer that uses a centralized offer library and a decision engine driven by Real-Time Customer Profile data to select the best offer for each customer across touchpoints, with decisions and related events exported into Adobe Experience Platform datasets for analysis and batch delivery.

resources.label: OpenAI Ads Integration
resources.description: OpenAI Ads Integration onboards OpenAI Ads—the ChatGPT conversational ad format—as a new publisher in Adobe Advertising Search, Social, & Commerce for consolidated campaign management and reporting alongside other publishers, while exposing the same OpenAI campaigns and ads in Adobe Advertising DSP as a dedicated Conversational Ads surface so advertisers can create, launch, and monitor ChatGPT ads without leaving Adobe Advertising.

resources.label: Operational Insights Agent
resources.description: Operational Insights Agent is an Experience Platform agentic capability that exposes operational metrics and anomaly detection across audiences, datasets, schemas, destinations and journeys in AI Assistant, and is invoked by other agents such as Audience, Journey and Data Engineering to provide practitioners with fast, conversational operational insight.

resources.label: Adobe PDF Accessibility Auto-Tag API
resources.description: Adobe PDF Accessibility Auto-Tag API is an Acrobat Services API that uses AI to automatically tag PDFs for accessibility—headings, reading order, and structure—and can generate a detailed accessibility report, available as part of the Acrobat Services family and through Adobe PDF Services integrations.

resources.label: Adobe PDF Electronic Seal API
resources.description: Adobe PDF Electronic Seal API is an Acrobat Services API that applies a tamper-evident electronic seal to PDFs at scale using certificates from trust service providers on Adobe's Approved Trust List (AATL), helping verify document identity and integrity for invoices, financial statements, and other regulated workflows, and is included with the PDF Services API.

resources.label: Adobe PDF Embed API
resources.description: Adobe PDF Embed API is a free, client-side JavaScript API from Acrobat Services that embeds a rich PDF viewer in web applications, providing consistent in-browser document viewing along with collaboration, review workflows and analytics integration.

resources.label: Adobe PDF Extract API
resources.description: Adobe PDF Extract API is an Acrobat Services API that uses machine learning to unlock unstructured content in PDFs by extracting text, complex tables, images, figures, and document structure into structured data (such as JSON) for analytics, AI, and downstream processing, offered alongside Adobe PDF Services API within Acrobat Services.

resources.label: Import/Export PDF Form Data
resources.description: The Import PDF Form Data and Export PDF Form Data operations in the PDF Services API let developers programmatically read form field values from, and write them into, interactive PDF forms (AcroForm and static XFA) at scale. Export returns field data as structured JSON or CSV key-value pairs (and can emit an empty schema from a blank form), while Import takes the same formats to pre-populate forms, with dynamic XFA forms rejected by design.

resources.label: PDF Properties
resources.description: The PDF Properties operation in the PDF Services API retrieves comprehensive PDF metadata and properties—including page count, PDF version, encryption and permission details, compliance levels (PDF/A, PDF/X, PDF/UA, etc.), fonts, XMP and Info dictionary fields, and optional page-level content/structure (images, text, scanned pages, tagging). It is exposed as pdfproperties in the PDF Services API and surfaced in tools like the Adobe PDF Services connector ("Get PDF Properties") in Power Automate.

resources.label: Adobe PDF Services API
resources.description: Adobe's developer API for programmatic PDF operations — creating, converting, recognising text in, extracting from and manipulating documents inside applications and pipelines.

resources.label: PDF Spaces
resources.description: PDF Spaces is an AI-powered workspace in Acrobat Studio where you bring together up to 100 files, links, notes, audio and text summaries, and an AI Assistant into a single conversational knowledge hub, then share it as a custom guided experience with citation-backed question answering and generative outputs such as podcasts and presentations.

resources.label: PDF Spaces Sharing
resources.description: PDF Spaces Sharing in Acrobat Studio lets you share an AI-powered workspace that bundles files, notes, audio overviews, insights, and an AI Assistant into a single guided experience instead of multiple attachments. Collaborators can work in the same space with controlled permissions, branded layouts, and engagement tracking (views, shares, time spent).

resources.label: PDF Watermark
resources.description: The PDF Watermark operation in the PDF Services API adds a watermark to a PDF by applying a supplied watermark document (typically a single-page PDF or image) across selected pages, with controls for page ranges, front- vs back-placement, positioning, rotation, and opacity. Text-only watermark options are planned and may not be available in all SDKs or deployments, so the capability should be described as document/image-based watermarking rather than guaranteed text watermark support.

resources.label: Adobe PhoneGap Build
resources.description: Adobe's former cloud service that packaged HTML, CSS and JavaScript mobile applications into native app binaries.

resources.label: Adobe Photoshop
resources.description: Adobe Photoshop is the industry-standard professional raster image-editing and compositing application for photos, graphics, and digital artwork, with advanced tools for layers, masking, and retouching plus generative AI features like Generative Fill powered by Adobe Firefly.

resources.label: Adobe Photoshop Elements
resources.description: Adobe Photoshop Elements is consumer photo-editing software that uses AI and step-by-step Guided Edits to help people organize, enhance, and create with their photos, offered as a non-subscription 3-year term license.

resources.label: Adobe Photoshop Express
resources.description: Adobe Photoshop Express is a free, cross-platform photo app that streamlines core Photoshop tools into quick actions—one-tap filters, powerful AI-backed retouching, and multi-layer collages—for fast, high-quality image edits and social-ready output on mobile and Windows devices.

resources.label: Adobe Photoshop (web)
resources.description: Photoshop on the web is a browser-based version of Photoshop that lets you open cloud documents and edit images with many of Photoshop's most common tools and generative AI capabilities, directly in Chrome, Edge, or Firefox, without installing the desktop app.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Platform Location Service
resources.description: Places Service is a geo-location service with a flexible database of points of interest (POIs) and rich metadata, plus mobile SDK extensions and Launch rules that let apps act on entry and exit events and geo-attributes to drive real-time, location-aware targeting and personalization across Adobe Experience Cloud solutions.

resources.label: Adobe Portfolio
resources.description: Adobe Portfolio is a hosted website builder included with most Creative Cloud plans that lets creatives quickly build and customize personal portfolio sites, tightly integrated with Behance and Lightroom to publish and showcase their work.

resources.label: Adobe Prelude
resources.description: Adobe's former pre-production application for ingesting camera media, logging clips, and assembling rough-cut sequences to prepare footage for editing, now discontinued with its ingest and logging workflows moved into the Prelude workspace and related tools inside Adobe Premiere.

resources.label: Adobe Premiere Elements
resources.description: Adobe Premiere Elements is consumer video-editing software that simplifies editing with AI tools, automation, and Guided Edits to help users cut, enhance, and share polished videos, offered as a non-subscription 3-year term license.

resources.label: Adobe Premiere (Mobile)
resources.description: The mobile surface of Premiere for editing and publishing video on phones and tablets with the Premiere editing model in a touch-first form.

resources.label: Adobe Premiere Pro
resources.description: Adobe's professional non-linear video-editing application for film, television, and online video, combining timeline editing, color, audio, and delivery tools with AI-powered workflows in the Adobe Premiere family.

resources.label: Adobe Premiere Rush
resources.description: Adobe's former lightweight video-editing application for quick edits on phones and desktops, discontinued and replaced by Premiere on mobile (available on iPhone and Android) and Premiere on desktop.

resources.label: Presentation Left Red Stripe
resources.description: The fixed Adobe Red vertical stripe at the extreme left edge of Adobe's official presentation template — template chrome and a recognisable Adobe presentation cue, never a general-purpose motif.

resources.label: Privacy Service in Adobe Experience Platform
resources.description: Adobe Experience Platform Privacy Service provides a RESTful API and user interface to submit and orchestrate privacy access, delete, and opt-out requests across Adobe Experience Cloud applications; it relies on Identity Service identity namespaces (including ECID and other identifiers) to locate and process the relevant data in Experience Platform's data lake and Profile store.

resources.label: Product Advisor Agent
resources.description: Adobe's product-recommendation agent in Brand Concierge that advises end customers in real time, using unified profiles, behavioural data and business rules to recommend products, plans or offers.

resources.label: Adobe Product Analytics
resources.description: Adobe Product Analytics is a capability within Customer Journey Analytics, built on Adobe Experience Platform, that gives product managers self-service product usage analytics—including journeys, funnels, retention, and cohorts—so they can optimize digital product experiences rather than marketing campaigns.

resources.label: Product Knowledge Agent
resources.description: Adobe's product-knowledge question-answering agent that powers AI Assistant and other applications by answering how-to and conceptual questions about Adobe products using Experience League and other official documentation, returning grounded, cited responses.

resources.label: Product Support Agent
resources.description: Product Support Agent is the CX Enterprise agent surfaced through AI Assistant in Real-Time CDP, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Customer Journey Analytics, and AEM, helping users troubleshoot product issues in-context, create support tickets, and track case progress without leaving their workflows.

resources.label: Adobe Productivity Agent
resources.description: Adobe's productivity agent brings decades of Acrobat document intelligence into a single agentic interface that uses AI planning and tool orchestration to answer questions, power conversational PDF editing, and generate images, text and rich content like presentations, podcasts and social posts. It also underpins PDF Spaces, turning static files into interactive, branded experiences with tailored AI assistants, audio overviews and engagement insights.

resources.label: Programmatic TV
resources.description: Programmatic TV in Adobe Advertising DSP lets advertisers buy premium connected TV (CTV) video inventory programmatically, using dedicated Connected TV placements and ad types that run full-screen, unskippable ads before and during TV content across CTV devices and curated publisher inventory.

resources.label: Project Halo
resources.description: Project Halo (Customer Engagement for agile teams, final product name TBD) is an AI-first, conversational customer-engagement application for mid-market and departmental enterprise teams that turns prompts and briefs into end-to-end, multi-step, on-brand campaigns—spanning email and other channels—with integrated audience selection, activation, and analytics.

resources.label: Protect PDF
resources.description: Protect PDF is an Acrobat capability that lets you control who can open a PDF and what they can do with it by applying passwords or certificates, setting printing, copying, and editing permissions, and using 256-bit AES encryption, available as an online tool and within Acrobat.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Platform Query Service
resources.description: Experience Platform's SQL engine over Data Lake datasets, whose results can become new datasets for reporting, machine learning or Profile ingestion.

resources.label: Adobe Real-Time CDP
resources.description: Experience Platform's customer data platform application — unifying known and pseudonymous data into Real-Time Customer Profiles and activating audiences to destinations under governance controls.

resources.label: Adobe Real-Time CDP B2B Edition
resources.description: The B2B edition of Real-Time CDP — unifying person and account profiles and linking leads to accounts and opportunities for account-based segmentation and activation.

resources.label: Adobe Real-Time CDP Collaboration
resources.description: Adobe Real-Time CDP Collaboration is a limited-availability, purpose-built data-collaboration application that lets brands and publishers securely discover audience overlap, activate shared audiences, and measure campaign outcomes without exchanging underlying customer-level databases, using governed collaboration roles and patterns.

resources.label: Adobe Real-Time Customer Profile
resources.description: Real-Time Customer Profile merges data from multiple online and offline sources into unified, actionable customer profiles that include both attributes and time-series events, updating in near real time. These profiles, built on identity graphs and governed data, power segmentation, Real-Time CDP audiences, journeys, and activation across channels.

resources.label: Reporting & Insights
resources.description: The Content Supply Chain stage in which content and campaign performance is measured and fed back into planning.

resources.label: Adobe RoboHelp
resources.description: Adobe RoboHelp is a help-authoring application for creating and delivering online help, knowledge base, and policy and procedure content, including microcontent for chatbots and search snippets. It publishes to multiple formats such as frameless and responsive HTML5, PDF, mobile apps, and other knowledge base outputs to serve customers across web and mobile touchpoints.

resources.label: Sales Qualifier
resources.description: Sales Qualifier is an AI-driven add-on application to Adobe Journey Optimizer B2B Edition that implements the Account Qualification Agent to help sales and BDR teams identify, qualify, and act on high-intent accounts and buying groups. It automates prospect qualification, outreach, and buyer-engagement workflows across channels to reduce manual BDR load and accelerate pipeline velocity.

resources.label: Adobe Scan
resources.description: Adobe Scan is a free iOS and Android mobile app that uses Adobe Sensei to capture paper documents, whiteboards, forms, business cards, and receipts and convert them into high-quality, editable, searchable PDFs stored in Adobe Document Cloud.

resources.label: Schema Registry in Adobe Experience Platform
resources.description: Adobe Experience Platform Schema Registry is the XDM modeling service that provides a UI (Schema Editor) and REST API to define and manage classes, schemas, field groups, and data types; customer experience data, including profiles and identities, is stored in datasets that conform to these XDM schemas.

resources.label: Demo and Technical Execution
resources.description: An Adobe seller learning journey focused on demo mastery, technical talks, integrations, labs, and technical pre-sales execution.

resources.label: Discovery and Qualification
resources.description: An Adobe seller learning journey focused on discovery, qualification, account planning, and evaluating opportunity fit.

resources.label: Just-in-Time Learning
resources.description: An Adobe seller learning journey: targeted resources and updates that support learning in the flow of work.

resources.label: Path to Excellence
resources.description: An Adobe seller learning journey: the technical-oriented learning path used in product enablement materials for technical pre- and post-sales audiences.

resources.label: Path to Readiness
resources.description: An Adobe seller learning journey: the sales-oriented learning path used in product enablement materials for sellers and general field audiences.

resources.label: Product Foundations
resources.description: An Adobe seller learning journey: the entry path covering technology, product basics, market need and core product walkthroughs.

resources.label: Value-Driven Deal Progression
resources.description: An Adobe seller learning journey focused on progressing deals through value-led discovery, objection handling, measurement partnership, and mitigation of risk before close.

resources.label: Value Positioning
resources.description: An Adobe seller learning journey focused on unlocking customer value, target profiles, differentiators, and product value positioning.

resources.label: Commercial Account Seller
resources.description: An Adobe seller learner persona that owns the commercial outcome on an account or opportunity – account strategy, executive relationships, deal orchestration, and book-of-business growth. Its core learning needs are: customer discovery and qualification; business value articulation and business-case framing; negotiation and commercial progression; account planning and whitespace strategy; executive storytelling and multi-threading.

resources.label: Partner Sales
resources.description: An Adobe seller learner persona that builds partner GTM, joint pipeline and partner enablement across the ecosystem. Its core learning needs are: partner strategy and joint GTM; partner pipeline creation and whitespace; partner accountability and practice development; enablement of partner sellers.

resources.label: Pipeline Generator
resources.description: An Adobe seller learner persona that creates and qualifies early-stage pipeline for aligned sellers. Its core learning needs are: prospecting and account-based outreach; early qualification and lead progression; product foundations and value hooks; messaging and objection basics.

resources.label: Post-Sale Growth & Renewal
resources.description: An Adobe seller learner persona that drives adoption, value realisation, retention, renewal and expansion across the installed base. Its core learning needs are: onboarding and adoption strategy; value realisation and customer outcomes; health and risk signals and escalation; renewal motion and commercial hygiene; expansion and cross-sell identification.

resources.label: Solution Specialist
resources.description: An Adobe seller learner persona for specialist sellers who bring deep single-solution value, use-case selling and competitive positioning. Its core learning needs are: deep single-solution value proposition; use-case and application selling; competitive differentiation; solution discovery and qualification; scope, pricing and business-case contribution.

resources.label: Technical Pre-Sales
resources.description: An Adobe seller learner persona that wins the technical decision – technical discovery, demo mastery, validation, and architecture guidance. Its core learning needs are: technical discovery and requirements shaping; demo mastery and technical storytelling; technical validation and proof; architecture patterns and integration (architect tier); strong pre-sales to post-sales handoff.

resources.label: Account Director
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the core sellers and account owners family responsible for overall account leadership, ecosystem orchestration, executive relationships, forecast discipline; it resolves to the Commercial Account Seller learner persona.

resources.label: Account Executive
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the core sellers and account owners family responsible for commercial growth and deal ownership; opportunity progression, qualification, negotiation, pipeline creation; it resolves to the Commercial Account Seller learner persona.

resources.label: Account Manager
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the core sellers and account owners family responsible for book-of-business ownership for named / installed-base accounts; relationship management, whitespace, renewal readiness; it resolves to the Commercial Account Seller learner persona. NAM (Named Account Manager) is a coverage label on this family, not a distinct role.

resources.label: Business Development Representative
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the pipeline generation family responsible for outbound prospecting, qualification, account-based outreach; it resolves to the Pipeline Generator learner persona.

resources.label: Campaign Operations
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the marketing family responsible for campaign setup and execution coordination across sales, demand, and business systems to support timely campaign delivery; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning. Marketing operations cohort retained for communications and readiness planning.

resources.label: Channel Account Manager
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the partner sales family that builds and maintains channel-partner relationships to drive indirect sales; supports quote / pricing, partner enablement, reseller growth, renewals, and expansion through the channel; it resolves to the Partner Sales learner persona.

resources.label: Compensation and Territory Operations
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the operations and change family responsible for territory alignment, compensation-impacting data and processes, and coverage attribution support; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning. Operational support cohort for readiness and communications.

resources.label: Customer Business Advisor
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the specialist overlays family: an advisory specialist who shapes solution strategy with the customer; it resolves to the Solution Specialist learner persona.

resources.label: Customer Engineer
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the adjacent and overlay roles family: a support and engineering role; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning.

resources.label: Customer Retention Marketing
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the marketing family responsible for adoption, advocacy, retention, and expansion-support campaigns for existing customers; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning. Customer-marketing cohort retained for communications and readiness planning.

resources.label: Customer Success Manager
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the post-sale growth and value family responsible for adoption, value realisation, health / risk mitigation, QBRs, retention support, and advocacy; it resolves to the Post-Sale Growth & Renewal learner persona.

resources.label: Customer Success Specialist
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the post-sale growth and value family responsible for time-bound or specialist success engagements focused on adoption, value measurement, and post-sales guidance; it resolves to the Post-Sale Growth & Renewal learner persona.

resources.label: Data Steward
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the operations and change family responsible for data-quality stewardship for opportunities, contracts, coverage, and reporting-critical sales data; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning. Operational support cohort for readiness and communications.

resources.label: Deal Desk
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the operations and change family responsible for contract drafting and changes, deal-structure review, and coordination with finance and bookings teams before processing; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning. Operational support cohort for readiness and communications.

resources.label: Demand Generation
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the marketing family responsible for campaign planning and execution to create new-business leads, increase engagement, and pass qualified leads to sales; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning. Marketing cohort retained for communications and readiness planning.

resources.label: Digital Strategy Group
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the adjacent and overlay roles family: an advisory support function covering industry trends, best practice, thought leadership and strategic point of view, not a field-selling role; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning. Its enablement need (industry trends, best practice, thought leadership) is distinct from the seller personas; it is the strongest candidate for its own learner persona if dedicated enablement is later designed for it.

resources.label: Enterprise Architect
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the technical pre-sales family responsible for future-state architecture, integration patterns, scalability, executive technical credibility; it resolves to the Technical Pre-Sales learner persona.

resources.label: Expert SC
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the technical pre-sales family responsible for expert-level features, tailored demos, hardest customer scenarios; it resolves to the Technical Pre-Sales learner persona.

resources.label: Field Partner Sales Manager
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the partner sales family that develops and executes partner strategy for aligned sales teams; defines territory plans; drives partner alignment in whitespace; represents the partner point of view on deal progression; serves as primary partner contact for field teams; provides reporting and quarterly reviews; drives joint close-plan accountability; it resolves to the Partner Sales learner persona.

resources.label: Global Account Director
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the core sellers and account owners family responsible for global / multi-BU account leadership across regions; it resolves to the Commercial Account Seller learner persona.

resources.label: Inside Sales Representative
resources.description: A legacy, overloaded Adobe field label that names a territory-carrying role or an overlay role in DMe and sits near renewals or support in older DX material. It is never resolved to a learner persona without the business unit confirming which role is meant; the candidates are Pipeline Generator, Commercial Account Seller and Post-Sale Growth & Renewal.

resources.label: Internal Sales Operations Help Desk
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the operations and change family responsible for frontline support for sales-ops issues, access, and process troubleshooting; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning. Operational support cohort for readiness and communications.

resources.label: Marketing Data Analyst
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the marketing family responsible for campaign and engagement reporting, performance visibility, and insight support for marketing programmes; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning. Marketing analytics cohort retained for communications and readiness planning.

resources.label: Marketing Data Product Owner
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the marketing family responsible for product / data ownership for marketing-data capabilities, standards, and system-backed workflows; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning. Marketing data-governance cohort retained for communications and readiness planning.

resources.label: Marketing Operations
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the marketing family responsible for marketing-technology configuration, process / workflow design, campaign-system coordination, and lead-management support; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning. Marketing operations cohort retained for communications and readiness planning.

resources.label: Order Management
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the operations and change family responsible for booking and order processing across products and regions; sales-order operational execution; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning. Operational support cohort for readiness and communications.

resources.label: Partner-Facing Partner Sales Manager
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the partner sales family responsible for direct ownership of strategic partner relationships; grows the partner's Adobe practice end-to-end; leads joint GTM planning, executive alignment, and partner-attributed pipeline cultivation through closure; it resolves to the Partner Sales learner persona.

resources.label: Partner Manager
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the partner sales family responsible for partner portfolio management, demand generation support, partner sourcing support, and practice development; it resolves to the Partner Sales learner persona. Keep alias-bearing because some pages use partner manager generically.

resources.label: Partners
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the operations and change family: the external ecosystem participants engaged in pipeline creation, deal progression and value realisation; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning. External cohort retained for change-impact and enablement-reach planning.

resources.label: Product Specialist
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the specialist overlays family responsible for product-specific value narrative, cross-sell and upsell, and single-solution opportunities; it resolves to the Solution Specialist learner persona. Product Specialist is the DX name for the role.

resources.label: Product Success Manager
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the specialist overlays family responsible for specialist support for Solution Specialists focused on driving quality pipeline by optimising customer experience, product adoption, and product usage; it resolves to the Solution Specialist learner persona. A DMe role, distinct from Partner Sales Manager; PSM is never used without expansion.

resources.label: Professional Services Delivery
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the adjacent and overlay roles family: the Professional Services delivery role; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning.

resources.label: Professional Services Sales
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the adjacent and overlay roles family that sells services / ACS motion alongside software opportunities; it resolves to the Solution Specialist learner persona. Revenue-carrying services overlay aligned to commercial motions.

resources.label: Professional Services Seller
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the adjacent and overlay roles family: the operational or change-impact label some release and readiness materials use for the Professional Services selling population; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning. Keep distinct from PSS unless the owning programme explicitly normalises them together.

resources.label: Regional SC
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the technical pre-sales family responsible for region-assigned SC coverage and demo-environment alignment; it resolves to the Technical Pre-Sales learner persona.

resources.label: Renewal Sales Specialist
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the renewal and installed base family responsible for subscription renewals, quote and contract continuity, renewal readiness planning, and renewal-driven upsell expansion; it resolves to the Post-Sale Growth & Renewal learner persona. Owns the renewal motion; primary account contact remains AE, AD, PS, SAM, or AM depending on model.

resources.label: Sales Development Representative
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the pipeline generation family responsible for inbound / outbound lead qualification and early pipeline progression; it resolves to the Pipeline Generator learner persona.

resources.label: Sales Operations Manager
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the operations and change family responsible for sales-operating-process governance, field process support, and run-the-business coordination; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning. Operational support cohort for readiness and communications.

resources.label: Sales Operations Systems
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the operations and change family responsible for sales-system administration, process tooling, and systems support for sales workflows; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning. Operational support cohort for readiness and communications.

resources.label: Sales Specialist
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the specialist overlays family: a quota-carrying specialist seller for one solution line; it resolves to the Solution Specialist learner persona.

resources.label: Solution Account Manager
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the post-sale growth and value family responsible for post-sale account coordination, onboarding, value realisation, customer-health oversight, support escalation coordination, and expansion lead identification; it resolves to the Post-Sale Growth & Renewal learner persona.

resources.label: Solution Architect
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the technical pre-sales family responsible for cross-solution / architecture-heavy technical guidance, above SC; it resolves to the Technical Pre-Sales learner persona.

resources.label: Solution Partner Program
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the operations and change family responsible for programme administration and operational support for solution-partner motions; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning. Change-impact / ecosystem-operational cohort.

resources.label: Solution Specialist
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the specialist overlays family responsible for solution-led value, use-case selling and competitive positioning; it resolves to the Solution Specialist learner persona. Solution Specialist is the DMe name for the role.

resources.label: Solutions Consultant
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the technical pre-sales family responsible for technical discovery, demos, validation, solution recommendation; it resolves to the Technical Pre-Sales learner persona.

resources.label: Partner Technical Pre-Sales
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the technical pre-sales family responsible for partner-delivered technical pre-sales readiness; it resolves to the Technical Pre-Sales learner persona.

resources.label: Technical Validation
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the technical pre-sales family responsible for technical fit, evaluation and proof; it resolves to the Technical Pre-Sales learner persona.

resources.label: Value Success Manager
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the post-sale growth and value family responsible for installed-base relationship management for value realisation, health improvement, and growth; it resolves to the Post-Sale Growth & Renewal learner persona. Business terminology overlaps with CSM / SAM families in some systems; retain as an explicit alias-bearing role.

resources.label: All Learner Personas
resources.description: An Adobe seller targeting group that selects every learner persona in the model. Today extensionally identical to all_sellers because all six learner personas sell; the two differ in intent – 'all' tracks the complete learner-persona list as the model evolves, while 'all_sellers' stays scoped to selling personas; it is a targeting convenience that expands to its member personas and carries no learner profile of its own.

resources.label: All Sellers
resources.description: An Adobe seller targeting group that selects every selling persona – the full field selling motion: commercial and technical, direct and partner, new business and post-sale growth; it is a targeting convenience that expands to its member personas and carries no learner profile of its own.

resources.label: All Technical
resources.description: An Adobe seller targeting group that selects all technical selling personas (solutions consultant through architect sub-tiers); it is a targeting convenience that expands to its member personas and carries no learner profile of its own. Single-persona group today; kept as a group so any future technical persona joins automatically without retagging content.

resources.label: Adobe Send & Track
resources.description: Adobe Send & Track is an Adobe Document Cloud online service that lets users send documents or shared links and track when recipients view or download them, available as a standalone service and as part of Acrobat PDF Pack.

resources.label: Adobe Sensei
resources.description: Adobe's brand for the machine-intelligence capabilities embedded across Creative Cloud, Document Cloud and Experience Cloud — auto-tagging, subject selection, personalisation scoring and anomaly detection — rather than a product sold on its own.

resources.label: Sensei GenAI
resources.description: Adobe Sensei GenAI is the generative-AI service layer in Adobe Experience Cloud that uses large language models and Firefly-compatible models to power features such as content generation in Adobe Journey Optimizer and Generate Variations and other genAI tools in Adobe Experience Manager Sites and Assets. These services create on-brand marketing copy, images, and content variants from prompts and context, and are exposed through product-specific genAI experiences and AI Assistant.

resources.label: Site Optimization Agent
resources.description: Site Optimization Agent is the GenAI-first agent behind Adobe Experience Manager Sites Optimizer that automatically diagnoses issues in site performance, traffic acquisition, and content engagement, then generates prescriptive code and content suggestions and can auto-implement approved fixes to improve business outcomes.

resources.label: Sources in Adobe Experience Platform
resources.description: Sources are Adobe Experience Platform's connectors that ingest data from Adobe, first-party, and third-party applications—including cloud storage, databases, CRM systems, and streaming sources—into Platform's data lake and Real-Time Customer Profile.

resources.label: Adobe Spark
resources.description: Adobe's former suite of template-driven web and mobile applications—Spark Post, Spark Page, and Spark Video—for creating social graphics, web pages, and short videos, discontinued and with their creative capabilities folded into the new Adobe Express app.

resources.label: Adobe Stock
resources.description: Adobe Stock is a royalty-free stock service that provides millions of high-quality photos, videos, illustrations, vector graphics, templates, 3D assets, motion graphics templates, and audio tracks, integrated so designers can search and license assets on stock.adobe.com and directly inside supported Creative Cloud applications.

resources.label: Adobe Story Plus
resources.description: Adobe's former script-writing and production-planning service for developing scripts and organising productions.

resources.label: Student Spaces in Acrobat
resources.description: Student Spaces in Acrobat is a free, AI-powered study workspace on Acrobat web and Android where students organize up to 100 files per space and turn course materials into flashcards, quizzes, study guides, mind maps/cheat sheets, audio summaries, podcasts, video summaries, and presentations, all backed by citations. A built-in AI tutor helps explain concepts, and students can share spaces with classmates to collaborate on group projects, with premium tools like Podcast, Presentation, and Video Summary unlocked via a free Adobe account.

resources.label: Adobe Substance 3D
resources.description: Adobe Substance 3D is Adobe's 3D design suite—including Painter, Designer, Sampler, Stager, and Modeler—for authoring materials, texturing and staging 3D scenes, and rendering realistic visuals, offered under Adobe's Creative Cloud 3D & AR plans.

resources.label: Adobe Substance 3D Designer
resources.description: Substance 3D's procedural material-authoring application — node-based creation of tileable, parametric materials.

resources.label: Adobe Substance 3D Modeler
resources.description: Adobe Substance 3D Modeler is a 3D modeling, sculpting, and assembly application that lets artists shape forms with intuitive brush-based tools across both desktop and VR, enabling fast ideation of organic and hard-surface objects and scenes before export to other 3D tools.

resources.label: Adobe Substance 3D Painter
resources.description: Substance 3D's texture-painting application for painting materials and details directly onto 3D models.

resources.label: Adobe Substance 3D Sampler
resources.description: Substance 3D's application for converting photographs and captures into usable 3D materials.

resources.label: Adobe Substance 3D Stager
resources.description: Substance 3D's scene staging and rendering application — assembling models, materials, lighting and cameras into finished product shots.

resources.label: Tags in Adobe Experience Platform
resources.description: Experience Platform's tag-management capability — client-side rules, data elements and extensions with development, staging and production environments and a publishing workflow for deploying data-collection and marketing technologies.

resources.label: Adobe Target
resources.description: Adobe's testing and personalisation application — A/B and multivariate testing plus rules-based and AI-driven personalisation of digital experiences.

resources.label: Adobe Technical Communication Suite
resources.description: Adobe Technical Communication Suite is Adobe's bundle of four applications—Adobe FrameMaker, Adobe RoboHelp, Adobe Captivate, and Adobe Acrobat—for creating, managing, and delivering technical documentation, eLearning, help, and other business content.

resources.label: Time Series Agent
resources.description: Adobe's time-series analysis agent within Audience Agent that answers natural-language questions about historical audience sizes, comparing current sizes to past values and flagging audiences whose size has changed significantly over configurable periods.

resources.label: Adobe Visitor ID Service
resources.description: Adobe Visitor ID Service is the legacy JavaScript library that assigns a universal Experience Cloud ID (ECID) shared across CX Enterprise solutions such as Analytics, Audience Manager and Target; it is distinct from Adobe Experience Platform Identity Service, and when using the Adobe Experience Platform Web SDK you typically rely on its built-in identity capabilities rather than deploying the Visitor ID Service library.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Platform Web SDK
resources.description: Adobe's client-side JavaScript library that sends website data to the Experience Platform Edge Network and receives audience qualifications and personalised content back.

resources.label: Workflow Optimization Agent
resources.description: Workflow Optimization Agent is an AI-powered workflow intelligence agent in Adobe Workfront that boosts team productivity by automatically monitoring project health, surfacing risks and priorities, and recommending smarter ways to organize and progress work.

resources.label: Workflow & Planning
resources.description: Workflow & Planning is the first Content Supply Chain phase, where campaign strategy is translated into structured work—defining audiences, journeys, channels, briefs, plans, calendars, budgets, and KPIs so content creation is aligned with business goals from the outset.

resources.label: Adobe Workfront
resources.description: Adobe Workfront is Adobe's cloud-based enterprise work-management platform that serves as a centralized system of record for planning, executing, and tracking work across marketing, creative, IT, and other teams, connecting strategy to projects, workflows, approvals, resource management, and integrated Adobe Creative Cloud and Experience Cloud tools.

resources.label: Adobe Workfront Planning
resources.description: Adobe Workfront Planning is the strategic planning module in Workfront that centralizes campaigns and initiatives in connected workspaces, linking goals, budgets, timelines, and downstream projects to bring fragmented planning data into a single location for enterprise-wide collaboration and orchestration.

resources.label: Adobe Workfront Workflow
resources.description: Adobe Workfront Workflow is the execution module that turns plans into projects and tasks, orchestrating multi-stage reviews and approvals, automating work intake and routing, and providing reporting and resource management so teams can execute campaigns and initiatives cohesively across the organization.

resources.label: Adobe XD
resources.description: Adobe's UI/UX design and collaboration application for screen experiences, supporting wireframing, interface design, interaction design, prototyping, UX animation, and sharing interactive prototypes across web and mobile.

resources.label: Adult Professional Learner
resources.description: Adult professional with self-directed learning preferences.

resources.label: Agent Skill
resources.description: A packaged folder of instructions — a skill manifest plus scripts, references and assets — teaching an LLM agent a repeatable workflow through progressive disclosure and a frontmatter trigger contract, as originated by Claude Agent Skills.

resources.label: Agent Tool Metadata And Trust
resources.description: Metadata an agent acts on — tool descriptions and annotations, agent memory, traces and trust — and the evidence that it is both a selection lever and a high-success attack surface.

resources.label: Agentic Data Analytics
resources.description: How to make LLM agents reliable for business analytics — the three failure modes, the four-layer agentic data stack, and the eval and ablation discipline.

resources.label: Agentic Instructional Pipeline
resources.description: Multi-agent orchestration architecture for producing learning content — an autonomy spectrum, architect-writer-assessor-packager patterns with human-in-the-loop gates, retrieval grounding and validation passes.

resources.label: Ai Artifacts
resources.description: Practitioner reference to AI artifact surfaces — Claude, Cowork and Claude Code variants plus Canvas and Codex Sites, their APIs and hard limits.

resources.label: AI Assessment Regulation
resources.description: Legal and compliance discipline for AI-mediated assessment — EU AI Act high-risk duties, GDPR Article 22 human review, and US municipal and state selection statutes as the source corpus records them.

resources.label: Ai Audio Production
resources.description: AI in the educational audio pipeline — neural TTS deployment, conversational-overview limits, AI-editing failure modes, series operations and the legal-governance stack.

resources.label: Ai Avatar Video
resources.description: Synthetic presenters and AI-generated video for learning — the independent evidence for parity-not-benefit, uncanny-valley risk, and consent and disclosure governance.

resources.label: UNESCO AI Competency Frameworks
resources.description: UNESCO's 2024 AI competency frameworks for teachers (five aspects by three levels) and students (four dimensions by three levels) — the human-centred, ethics-first baseline for AI capability in education.

resources.label: AI Content Detection
resources.description: Statistical classification of text as AI- or human-authored via perplexity and watermark signals, and its documented failure modes driving process-oriented verification instead.

resources.label: Ai For Elearning
resources.description: The DLI AI for eLearning module and DLI's 2024 Impact of AI report — AI definitions, myths, ethics and principles, and the AI tasks and tools DLI assigns to each ADDIE phase.

resources.label: Ai Image Generation
resources.description: Generating technical and learning visuals with AI — the Logical Utility vs Stylistic Illustration paradigms, model choice, image-prompt craft and ControlNet control.

resources.label: AI Learning Design System
resources.description: Layered specification for AI-generated courses — input schema, five-phase cycle, strip-card template, modality rules, evaluation, scope logic and quality assurance in unified and enhanced versions.

resources.label: Ai Optimization Methodology
resources.description: Systematic approach to converting human-readable content into compact, AI-friendly formats (YAML/JSON) for faster parsing and maintenance.

resources.label: Ai Translation And Localisation
resources.description: Translating and localising learning content with AI — MT quality evidence, cultural adaptation, layout expansion, privacy law and a four-tier risk-governance model.

resources.label: Alexander's Dialogue Principles
resources.description: Robin Alexander's dialogic teaching principles and the classroom-talk research behind them — IRF/IRE exchange structure, wait time, and the EEF efficacy trial.

resources.label: Alignment Marker
resources.description: References to instructional alignment — learning objectives, business goals, backward design, outcome mapping, objective-to-assessment alignment

resources.label: Ally
resources.description: A supporting character who assists the hero but does not lead the journey

resources.label: Ambiguous Signal
resources.description: Signal set that maps to multiple possible relations, requiring broader contextual reasoning to disambiguate — particularly common between concession and condition

resources.label: Analogy
resources.description: Comparison to a familiar concept used to explain or validate a claim

resources.label: Analytic Rubric
resources.description: Grid-based rubric (Criteria x Levels) providing detailed, granular feedback on specific performance dimensions.

resources.label: Analyze Verb
resources.description: Bloom's Level 4 action verbs indicating analysis-level learning objectives

resources.label: Anaphora
resources.description: Repetition of the same word or phrase at the start of successive clauses for emphasis

resources.label: Anaphora Marker
resources.description: Repeated word or phrase at the beginning of successive clauses

resources.label: Andragogy
resources.description: Malcolm Knowles's adult-learning theory that adults learn best when instruction is relevant, self-directed, experiential, problem-centred and intrinsically motivated, contrasting with pedagogy for dependent learners.

resources.label: Animation Only Carrier
resources.description: Essential information that can only be accessed via animation — inaccessible to static reading (anti-pattern)

resources.label: Animation Type
resources.description: Animation styles and motion graphics techniques used in learning content

resources.label: Antithesis
resources.description: Juxtaposition of contrasting ideas in parallel grammatical structure

resources.label: Apology Opener
resources.description: Anti-pattern — apologetic, self-deprecating, or preamble-heavy opening that signals low speaker confidence and reduces audience attention before the content begins

resources.label: Apply Verb
resources.description: Bloom's Level 3 action verbs indicating application-level learning objectives

resources.label: ARCS Model of Motivation
resources.description: John Keller's motivational design model structuring learning sequences through Attention, Relevance, Confidence and Satisfaction so engagement is planned rather than assumed.

resources.label: Argument Graph
resources.description: Directed graph where nodes are argumentative units (claims, evidence) and edges represent relationships (Support, Attack, Elaborates). Built from CESC (Claim Extraction with Stance Classification) and CEPE (Claim-Evidence Pair Extraction).

resources.label: Argument Mining Pipeline
resources.description: The five-stage computational pipeline for extracting argumentative structure from text — ADU segmentation, component classification, relation identification, structure construction, and scheme classification — with its standard corpora and modelling eras.

resources.label: Aristotelian Rhetoric
resources.description: Aristotle's classical persuasion architecture — the artistic proofs, kairos, the three genres, five canons, style registers and four-part arrangement.

resources.label: Art Direction
resources.description: The craft and direction of non-data visual assets — iconography systems, illustration parameter systems, photography art direction, and distinctive-brand-asset theory.

resources.label: Assertion Evidence Structure
resources.description: Michael Alley's strict slide grammar — a declarative sentence headline plus dominant visual evidence, with its typography rules, deck architecture and empirical record.

resources.label: Assessment As Learning
resources.description: Metacognitive assessment (AaL) where students personally monitor their own learning and use feedback to self-regulate.

resources.label: Assessment Ecosystem
resources.description: Earl's Assessment OF, FOR and AS Learning framework — functional intent, not the instrument alone, decides which assessment mode is in play and which educator role applies.

resources.label: Assessment For Learning
resources.description: Formative assessment (AfL) used diagnostically to tailor instruction and provide feedback during the learning process.

resources.label: Assessment Item Type
resources.description: Specific question or task formats used in assessments

resources.label: Assessment Method Selection
resources.description: Assessment-design discipline choosing the method for a purpose by weighting reliability, validity, educational impact, acceptability and cost — the van der Vleuten utility model and Miller's pyramid.

resources.label: Assessment Of Learning
resources.description: Summative assessment (AoL) focused on certification and accountability; occurs at the conclusion of a learning sequence.

resources.label: Assessment Type
resources.description: Types of assessments and evaluation methods

resources.label: Assistive Technology
resources.description: The assistive technologies learners use and what each asks of digital learning design — screen readers, OCR, captioning, adaptive keyboards, switches, AAC, text-to-speech, note-taking and voice recognition.

resources.label: Asynchronous Delivery Block
resources.description: References to self-paced, on-demand content delivery blocks within a course architecture

resources.label: Asynchronous Learning
resources.description: Self-paced learning where students progress through material independently without real-time instructor interaction.

resources.label: Attention Span During Lectures
resources.description: The evidence record that the 10–15-minute lecture attention-limit claim lacks a primary attention study, with cognitive backlog and mind wandering proposed as mechanisms instead of a fixed interval.

resources.label: Attribution Marker
resources.description: Explicit attribution of a claim to a named source — enables argument provenance tracking

resources.label: Audience Analysis
resources.description: The discipline of researching an audience's knowledge, disposition and four-part needs — functional, emotional, social, aspirational — before communicating, using psychological profiling frameworks.

resources.label: Audience As Hero
resources.description: Narrative principle where the audience is the protagonist and the presenter is the mentor/guide.

resources.label: Audience Design
resources.description: The cognitive process by which speakers tailor speech to a listener's knowledge — common-ground models, egocentric referential error under load, and neural-alignment evidence.

resources.label: Audio Element
resources.description: Audio production elements including voiceover, music, and sound design

resources.label: Authority Opener
resources.description: Strong, declarative opening statement that immediately establishes speaker authority — no throat-clearing, no apology, no agenda preamble

resources.label: Automated Deck Analysis Pipeline
resources.description: A multi-stage LLM pipeline that critiques slide decks — text-derived analysis, vision-model slide critique, deck flow, confidence-weighted synthesis — and its own audits.

resources.label: Automated Essay Scoring
resources.description: Machine scoring of essays predicting quality from text features — the PEG-to-Transformer lineage with length-proxy, demographic-bias and adversarial failure modes.

resources.label: Backward Design
resources.description: Wiggins and McTighe's Understanding by Design sequence — desired outcomes, then assessment evidence, then learning experiences — plus course-blueprint components and concept mapping as planning tools.

resources.label: Baked Text In Image
resources.description: Text embedded within a raster image rather than as real selectable text (WCAG 1.4.5 violation)

resources.label: Baldwin-Ford Transfer Model
resources.description: Baldwin and Ford's three-condition transfer model — trainee characteristics, training design, work environment — governing whether trained skills reach on-job performance.

resources.label: Bandura's Social Cognitive Theory
resources.description: Bandura's theory that learning occurs through observing others, mediated by self-efficacy, with person, behaviour and environment in reciprocal determinism.

resources.label: Bars Rubric
resources.description: Behaviorally Anchored Rating Scale; reduces rater ambiguity by providing observable behavioral examples for every point on the scale.

resources.label: Before After Comparison
resources.description: Explicit baseline-to-result contrast enabling ROI calculation — required structural component per Adobe Case Study Excellence Framework

resources.label: Behaviourism
resources.description: Learning theory based on the idea that knowledge is independent and exterior to the learner, who is a 'blank slate'. Focuses on conditioning and stimulus-response.

resources.label: Big Idea Framework
resources.description: Strategic message filter requiring a single sentence that articulates a unique POV and conveys what is at stake.

resources.label: Blended Learning Design
resources.description: Design discipline for learning delivered across modalities and time — blend taxonomies, modality-by-objective choice, flipped and cohort models, HyFlex delivery and the confounded evidence record for blended versus face-to-face comparisons.

resources.label: Blended Learning Sequence
resources.description: References to structured sequences that combine synchronous and asynchronous delivery blocks within a single learning path

resources.label: Bloom's Taxonomy
resources.description: Anderson and Krathwohl's revised six-level cognitive taxonomy from Remember through Create, used to align learning objectives, instructional activities and assessments to a target cognitive process level.

resources.label: Bluf Hook
resources.description: Bottom Line Up Front — leads immediately with the key conclusion or recommendation (executive default)

resources.label: Boost Marker
resources.description: Epistemic booster increasing claim certainty

resources.label: BOPPPS Model
resources.description: Six-component outcomes-focused session-pacing architecture — Bridge-In, Objectives, Pre-Assessment, Participatory Learning, Post-Assessment, Summary — giving roughly half of session time to participatory learning.

resources.label: Borderline Regression Method
resources.description: Data-centered standard setting method using linear regression of checklist scores and global ratings to predict cut-scores.

resources.label: Boundary By Contrast
resources.description: Defining concept edges by explicitly stating what it is NOT via reciprocal 'Use X instead' notes.

resources.label: Brain Dump Activity
resources.description: Maximum-effort retrieval activity requiring uncued reconstruction of all known information about a topic within a time limit.

resources.label: Brain Rules
resources.description: John Medina's twelve practitioner rules summarising how the brain learns, remembers and performs, recorded as taught with their learning-and-development design implications.

resources.label: Branching Scenario
resources.description: References to interactive branching scenario exercises where learner choices lead to different consequence paths

resources.label: Brand Element
resources.description: Brand identity components

resources.label: Bruner's Constructivist Instruction
resources.description: Bruner's theory of instruction emphasising discovery learning, scaffolding of representation modes (enactive, iconic, symbolic) and the spiral curriculum.

resources.label: Building Claude Skills
resources.description: How to author a single Claude skill — folder anatomy, progressive disclosure, the frontmatter contract, instruction writing, testing and distribution.

resources.label: A/B Testing
resources.description: The controlled-experiment method that splits traffic between two experience variants and measures which performs better against a defined goal metric before rolling the winner out.

resources.label: Attribution Modeling
resources.description: Assigning conversion credit across the marketing touchpoints that preceded an outcome — first-touch, last-touch or multi-touch — to reveal which activity drove results.

resources.label: Audience Segmentation
resources.description: Dividing a customer base into groups that share attributes or behaviours so each group can be targeted with relevant experiences.

resources.label: Buyer Audience
resources.description: People participating in a commercial buying decision, represented by explicit buying roles and personas.

resources.label: Champion
resources.description: Internal advocate driving the purchase decision forward

resources.label: Economic Buyer
resources.description: Executive with budget authority and final purchase approval

resources.label: Enterprise Buyer
resources.description: Large-organisation buyer characterised by complex procurement, multiple stakeholders, and extended sales cycles

resources.label: Influencer
resources.description: Stakeholder who shapes opinions but doesn't have final authority

resources.label: Smb Buyer
resources.description: Small or medium business buyer characterised by streamlined decisions, budget sensitivity, and personal rapport

resources.label: Technical Buyer
resources.description: Technical evaluator with product veto power based on technical requirements

resources.label: User Buyer
resources.description: End-user champion who will use the product daily

resources.label: Campaign Management
resources.description: Planning, executing and measuring outbound marketing campaigns across segments and channels — audience selection, scheduling, delivery and response tracking.

resources.label: Analytics Competitors
resources.description: Competitor market segment for digital analytics, customer insights, and attribution — vendors competing with Adobe Analytics and Customer Journey Analytics, principally Google Analytics 4, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Segment, and Heap.

resources.label: Content Management Competitors
resources.description: Competitor market segment for web CMS, headless CMS, and digital experience platforms — vendors competing with Adobe Experience Manager Sites and Assets, from enterprise DXPs (Sitecore, Optimizely, Contentful, Contentstack, Bloomreach, Drupal/Acquia) to SMB publishing platforms (WordPress, Squarespace, Wix).

resources.label: Creative Tools Competitors
resources.description: Competitor market segment for design, video, and creative collaboration — vendors competing with Creative Cloud, Firefly, and Express, spanning design tools (Figma, Sketch, Canva) and generative AI creation (Midjourney, Stability AI, Runway, Descript, Jasper, Typeface).

resources.label: Ecommerce Competitors
resources.description: Competitor market segment for commerce platforms, storefronts, and B2B commerce — vendors competing with Adobe Commerce, principally Shopify, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, BigCommerce, commercetools, WooCommerce, and Elastic Path.

resources.label: Marketing Automation Competitors
resources.description: Competitor market segment for email marketing, campaign orchestration, and lead nurturing — vendors competing with Adobe Marketo Engage, principally HubSpot, Salesforce Marketing Cloud (including Account Engagement, formerly Pardot), Oracle Eloqua, and Mailchimp.

resources.label: Search and Discovery Competitors
resources.description: Competitor market segment for site search, product discovery, and merchandising — vendors competing with Adobe Target and Adobe Commerce search, principally Algolia.

resources.label: Content Delivery Network
resources.description: A geographically distributed network of edge servers that caches and serves content close to users for speed and resilience.

resources.label: Customer Data Platform
resources.description: A system that unifies customer data from many sources into persistent, addressable individual profiles available for segmentation and activation.

resources.label: Customer Engagement Platform
resources.description: A system for managing ongoing, two-way customer interactions across channels — messages, offers and journeys that respond to individual behaviour.

resources.label: Customer Experience
resources.description: The customer's cumulative perception of a brand, formed across every interaction from first touch to support.

resources.label: Customer Journey Mapping
resources.description: Charting the end-to-end sequence of interactions a customer has with a brand across channels and time to expose gaps, friction and the moments that decide the relationship.

resources.label: Digital Asset Management
resources.description: A system for storing, tagging, governing and distributing digital assets at enterprise scale so approved assets are findable and reusable.

resources.label: Digital Experience Platform
resources.description: An integrated platform for building, managing, personalising and optimising digital experiences across channels.

resources.label: Headless CMS
resources.description: A content-management system that stores and serves content through APIs without prescribing the presentation layer, leaving rendering to any front end.

resources.label: Journey Orchestration
resources.description: Coordinating each individual customer's next interaction across channels in response to their real-time behaviour and state, rather than broadcasting the same campaign to a whole segment.

resources.label: Lead Scoring
resources.description: Ranking prospects by fit and engagement signals so sales effort concentrates on the leads most likely to convert.

resources.label: Marketing Automation
resources.description: Software that automates repeatable marketing work — email sequences, lead nurturing, scoring and campaign triggers — across the funnel.

resources.label: Multivariate Testing
resources.description: The experiment method that varies several elements of an experience at once to find the best-performing combination and each element's contribution.

resources.label: Omnichannel Marketing
resources.description: Coordinating consistent, connected customer messaging across every channel — email, web, mobile, paid media, in person — as one continuous experience rather than running channels in isolation.

resources.label: Personalization Engine
resources.description: A decisioning system that selects the content, offer or experience each individual receives from profile and behavioural data.

resources.label: Predictive Analytics
resources.description: Using statistical and machine-learning models over historical data to forecast customer behaviour — churn risk, conversion propensity, lifetime value — so action can be taken before the outcome occurs.

resources.label: Salesforce
resources.description: The software company whose CRM, marketing and commerce clouds compete with Adobe Experience Cloud applications.

resources.label: Salesforce Marketing Cloud
resources.description: Salesforce's cross-channel marketing application for email, mobile, advertising and journey management.

resources.label: Salesforce Sales Cloud
resources.description: Salesforce's CRM application for managing accounts, contacts, opportunities and the sales pipeline.

resources.label: Cadence
resources.description: The regular, scheduled operating rhythm of business reviews, standups, and executive checkpoints.

resources.label: Resolution
resources.description: The agreed commercial settlement or formal decision resolving a corporate dispute or bottleneck.

resources.label: Business-Evidence Arguments
resources.description: The experimental record on whether evidence-backed business arguments land — warrant explicitness, sidedness, confidence calibration and numeric framing.

resources.label: Business Persona Storytelling
resources.description: Tailoring B2B narratives to buyer role, using Adobe's four-persona framework and an L1–L4 multi-stakeholder narrative architecture.

resources.label: Business Storytelling Frameworks
resources.description: The structural narrative frameworks for professional communication — SOAR, Three-Act, SCQA, the Visual-Story Arc, StoryBrand, STAR — and the diagnostic toolkit.

resources.label: Buying Group Decision Making
resources.description: How executive and B2B buying committees actually decide — hidden profiles, status dynamics, pre-wiring, and why framing attenuates in expert rooms.

resources.label: Call To Action
resources.description: Direct requests for audience action or next steps

resources.label: Canonical Metadata Record
resources.description: Keeping one governing metadata record consistent across file formats — a canonical external record, one-way adapters, identity by IRI and digest, governed crosswalks and round-trip verification.

resources.label: Card Sorting
resources.description: Empirical research technique used to discover how people naturally understand and categorise information (Open, Closed, or Hybrid).

resources.label: Cartographic Projection and the Modifiable Areal Unit Problem
resources.description: The mathematics and statistical hazards of converting the Earth's surface into a flat map — geodetic datums and transformations, Tissot's Indicatrix distortion measure, the Modifiable Areal Unit Problem, and Web GIS practice.

resources.label: Case-Based Learning
resources.description: Pedagogy in which learners analyse realistic organisational narratives with incomplete information and a forced decision point to build transferable judgement schemas.

resources.label: Catalytic Feedback
resources.description: Feedback designed to accelerate learning rather than merely judge performance. Must be immediate, specific, archived for review, and aggregated to inform instructional improvement.

resources.label: Cause Marker
resources.description: Lexical marker signalling causal or consequential relationship

resources.label: Cdt Performance Levels
resources.description: CDT Performance Level Classification for learning objectives

resources.label: Claim-Evidence-Reasoning Framework
resources.description: McNeill and Krajcik's Claim-Evidence-Reasoning framework for constructing and assessing scientific arguments, extended by stance and evidence-type classification with a levelled quality rubric.

resources.label: Certainty Marker
resources.description: Lexical marker signalling high certainty or confidence

resources.label: Change Management Frameworks

A topic label names a subject without stating a thought.
